description: Large Xenomorph! The time if finally here to post a project I have been working on over the last month. After the recent set of my smaller Xenomorph models, I got peer-pressured into making one that was lifesized (ish). This model model stands 5ft tall from floor to tip of tail, measures almost 6ft long diagonally from the back foot to the tip of the head, and is almost 4 foot wide! In order to get it to fit through my doorways I ended up leaving the Head, Right Arm, and half othe tail removable and not fully glued in place. This project is not for everyone and requires quite a bit of dedication and printing resouces to make. At the time of the upload I only sliced the model to fit the H series and A2L printers (to maximize the the size of pieces I could print). Please note that if you are changing your printer from the current H2D that is seleted in the profile you may need to move some pieces around to make sure they fully fit within the build volume. Most are OK, but some have next to no wiggle room for placement. Please also note that the current profile is set to be printed with a .6mm nozzle. This helps speed up print time and the use the .3x layer heights* I printed my model with a very low infill amount (3-4% for most of the print) with the exception of some of the support/critical stress pieces where I increased the infill. This allowed to print quick and not use too much filament. I printed my model in MATTE PLA from Bambu, but due to the low infill amount, and the size/geometry of the model I REALLY wish I did it PETG so that I could display it outside and not worry about the tail melting/bending in the sun (still a risk with PETG I guess, but not as much). The assembly requires and advaced level of skill, this is not for first time large model printers. I did my best to make hexagonal pegs to help align everything, but you will likely need to sand all of the surfaces to ensure a good fit. I used CA glue on the pegs, with a 2-part expoxy to hold the flat surfaces together. To fill the joints I useda 2-part epoxy putty that I found on Amazon. Please note that the Base Tail section and the main body has an interference that I didn't catch until after the model was fully sliced and will need to be manually trimmed/sanded when doing the test fitting. I just used my scraper and knife to snip away bits of the main body until the tail section could fully fit. Please be careful test fitting pieces, due to the low infill amount it can be easy to break*** After the resin cured and the gaps were filled I sanded the joints using 320 grit sand paper before applying a bit of primer, and I used a Gloss Black spray paint to the the entire model. I ended up using a total of 6 spray paint cans* so plan accordingly. The Drool was accomplished using a 2-part epoxy resin (for fiberglass in my particular case) and I used some 2" brushes to coat the entire model and make it appear more wet than the gloss paint achieved by itself. To get the drool effect, I waited until the resin was just about dried, and kept applying over the mouth area until it didn't fully run off. A good/easier way to do this may be with some UV activated epoxy that cures in 5-10 seconds, but I have not tried this route. The teeth were painted in steps between the epoxy using an air brush.

description: 👽 THEM 1947 Disclosure Alien Greys – THE OBSERVER (3 Foot Edition) Some things are better left unseen... unfortunately, THE OBSERVER didn't get that memo. Standing an impressive 3 feet tall , THE OBSERVER is the largest member of the THEM 1947 Disclosure Alien Greys collection. Towering over the rest of the series, this life-sized display piece is guaranteed to turn heads, start conversations, and make your neighbors question whether they should be checking the skies a little more often. Designed with the classic Grey alien appearance in mind, THE OBSERVER features an oversized cranium, deep black eyes, an unnaturally slender body, and a slow, unsettling stance that makes it feel like it's quietly studying everyone around it. Whether displayed indoors, on your porch for Halloween, in a haunted house, or standing watch over your yard, this alien has an uncanny ability to make people stop and stare. Now... before anyone points it out... yes, he only has three toes on one foot. That's because aliens can get diabetes too. We don't judge around here. 😄 **There is also another file for the right foot having four toes if OCD has kicked in but it makes the base plate obsolete unless you remove the tabs from the postion for the right foot. 🛸 Model Information Approximately 3 feet (36") tall when assembled 7 build plates for the complete alien Optional display stand: 4 additional build plates for extra stability if you plan to display him outdoors or in high-traffic areas 1122.29g of Grey Filament for the Alien 29.83g of Black Filament for the Alien 420.91g of Black Filament for the Base 🖨️ Print Recommendations (MAKE SURE SUPPORTS ARE TURNED ON) While the prototype was successfully tested using KINGROON filament , I strongly recommend printing this model with Bambu Lab filament on a Bambu Grey Cool Plate . During testing, the Bambu filament consistently produced: Cleaner surface finish Better dimensional accuracy Less noticeable seams on glued joints More forgiving connector tolerances during assembly During testing, PLA KINGROON filament was printed using the standard textured build plate , while PLA Bambu filament was printed on the Bambu Grey Cool Plate . The Bambu combination consistently produced better print quality, smoother mating surfaces, and less noticeable seams after assembly. I also found that the Bambu parts were much more forgiving during test fitting. With the KINGROON prints, the connector tolerances were noticeably tighter, making assembly more difficult. If a part needed to be disassembled for adjustment, the connectors were much more susceptible to breaking. In many cases, you only had one chance to get the fit right before risking damage to the connector. The Bambu filament provided a better balance of strength and fit, making assembly considerably easier and more reliable. I also printed these with a Bambu P2S and the heads using a H2C and X2D 🔧 Assembly Assembly is straightforward using the keyed connectors. Dry-fitting each section before gluing is highly recommended to ensure proper alignment. Taking your time during assembly will reward you with an impressive display piece that looks like it walked straight out of a 1947 government file. 👽 Complete Your THEM 1947 Disclosure Alien Greys Collection Explore the rest of the series and bring the entire THEM 1947 Disclosure Alien Greys universe to life! 🛸 ROSWELL GREY 🔬 THE EXPERIMENTER 🚜 K.A.R.L. Android 21 (Evil) Realistic Multi-Color Parted Statue 1. Concept & Design This statue reimagines Android 21 (Majin form) with a realistic anatomical style while preserving her iconic dangerous aura and allure. The physique is intentionally stylized—finely detailed abdominal muscles, tense dynamic limbs, and a confident forward-leaning battle stance—amplifying the intimidating elegance behind her character. Engineered as a fully multi-color parted model, every major visual element is physically separated: her volumetric silver-gray hair, black tube top, gold arm rings, gloves, boots, belt, baggy pants, face features, and even her long pink tail. Each color exists as an individual printed part, meaning no AMS, no filament swapping required , yet the final assembly achieves a near-collectible finish straight off the print bed. 2. Engineering & Recommended Assembly Order The model is engineered to significantly reduce print time and failure risk. All parts are intentionally designed with forgiving tolerances. Since printers often vary slightly in dimensional accuracy, each part is meant to be joined securely using CA glue (super glue) . Gently heating joint areas with a heat gun before applying glue helps the adhesive cure faster and bond stronger. ⚠️ CRITICAL ASSEMBLY STEPS & PRO TIPS: To avoid top-heavy balance issues during gluing, please follow this precise assembly sequence : Upper Torso (Important Note): Assemble the upper chest and shoulders first , and then attach the black tube top clothing piece . This ensures a smooth fit and seamless alignment. Head & Hair Module: Combine the main volumetric hair and face piece first . Next, attach the neck and front bangs , and finally mount the complete head assembly onto the upper torso. Lower Body & Tail: Pre-assemble the pants, boots, and belt completely, then attach the pink tail . Final Upper-to-Lower Merge (Pro Tip): Complete the lower body group (pants + boots + belt + tail) first before joining it with the upper body. Installing top parts too early creates heavy top-weight from the massive hair, making lower joint gluing extremely difficult and forcing awkward holding angles while waiting for glue to set! 3. Display & Customization Although fully colored through part separation alone, painters may optionally enhance shadows on the black top, gold trims, or skin folds to further elevate realism. Her fierce stance and striking silhouette make this statue ideal as a standalone centerpiece or as part of a paired display alongside Majin Buu. The clean part boundaries also make it enjoyable for hobbyists who prefer hybrid finishing—mixing raw printed colors with light airbrush detailing. 4. Conclusion Following the release of Majin Buu, this Android 21 statue marks another exciting milestone in multi-color parted sculpture design. It delivers an accessible printing experience while maintaining professional visual depth. Your support and patience made this milestone possible, and more multi-color parted designs are actively in development. Quick Tips: For complex prints, avoid photography mode: It increases carriage travel and print failure risks. Calibrate your machine and use dry, stable filament to maximize printing reliability. Filament preference: Bambu’s gray remains my personal favorite. Cleanup tools: Needle-nose pliers and Bambu’s FAC002-N scraper make support removal significantly easier. description: St. Michael the Archangel - Classical Sculpture Lleva una pieza de arte clásico atemporal a tu hogar con esta escultura altamente detallada del Arcángel San Miguel. Este modelo representa la icónica y poderosa escena de San Miguel triunfando sobre Lucifer, sosteniendo la espada en una mano y la balanza de la justicia en la otra. Inspirado en las estatuas de mármol del Renacimiento y el Barroco europeo, cuenta con detalles intrincados en las alas plumadas, la armadura de estilo romano y los pliegues dinámicos de la capa. Instrucciones de impresión y montaje importantes: Para facilitar enormemente el proceso de impresión y reducir la complejidad de los soportes, el modelo está optimizado por partes. Tanto la espada como la balanza se imprimen por separado del cuerpo principal. Una vez impresas todas las piezas, los soportes se retiran de forma muy limpia y sencilla; después, solo debes encastrar y pegar los conectores en sus respectivas posiciones. Ajustes recomendados: Altura de capa: 0.12mm - 0.16mm (se recomienda una altura baja para capturar perfectamente el detalle del rostro y las plumas). Soportes: Sí, se recomiendan soportes de árbol automáticos (Tree Supports), los cuales se vuelven muy sencillos de retirar gracias al diseño por piezas. Relleno: 10% - 15% (de tipo Giroide para asegurar una buena resistencia interna). Filamentos sugeridos: PLA Mate Blanco, PLA efecto Mármol o Gris Pizarra para lograr un acabado auténtico de escultura de piedra.

description: In Book Five of the Odyssey , Odysseus is finally within sight of home when the sea itself turns against him. Poseidon, the Earth-Shaker, the dark-maned lord of the deep has not forgotten that this man blinded his son, the Cyclops Polyphemus. So he gathers the clouds, takes up his trident, and calls every wind down onto a single raft. This is that moment made solid. Not a calm sea-king on a throne, but the god rising out of his own storm: the wave curling into a fist beneath him, the trident already lifted, the grudge that will keep a hero wandering for ten more years. Homer never lets us forget that the sea has a memory, and a temper. I wanted the base to carry that: the water isn't scenery, it's Poseidon's will taking shape. Sculpted as a single figure rising from a sculptural mass of sea, so the wave does the storytelling instead of a second character competing for the eye.

description: “Big Chap” (Alien) Ultra Detailed Sculpture Staying on the recent Xenomorph Theme, here is another absoutley awesome, and highly detailed, “Big Chap” Xenomorph Sculpture! There are 2 size profiles being made available at the time of the model upload - 18" tall version as well as a 10" tall version. Please note that the 19" tall version is printed in pieces, and is maximized in size to fit the P/X series printer beds. The 10" tall version is printed a simplified one-piece print. I should know that I have printed 6 different size variants and will note that you can easily scale this between 10" and 19" tall models. **Please be aware that the print times are lengthy. I had 4 machines running test prints none stop. I promise though, it is worth it at the end. **Please also be aware that the model images you see are 100% real, with 0 use of AI, but they have been post-process colored using some Rub'n Buff waxes, 2-part epoxy resin, and then some gloss clear coat layer application at the end. ASSEMBLY REQUIRED ** Discard the small round cylinder that prints on the 2nd plate with the arms and foot. It is an uneeded part that was a result of slicing the model in the studio* The 19" tall, multipiece print will require some glue. I have used both super glue, as well as hot glue. Hot glue was my preference. With all the parts printed, and supports cleaned up (TAKE YOUR TIME REMOVING THE SUPPORTS AS THE PARTS ARE HIGHLY DETAILED AND FRAGILE ) do a dry-fit of all the parts to ensure proper fitment. You may need to file down some pieces if they do not fit. All 4 of my models went together with no issues, but different printers/filaments may have some tolerance issues. With the Dry fitting completed, if you are satisfied with the fitment you can take the piees apart and proceed to glue them together. As with the above test-fit process. If you are planning to paint/apply color to the model I highly advise doing so with Xenomorph OFF of the base. For final assembly, apply some glue to the foot mounting pegs and firmly place the model on to the base. COLOR APPLICATION I used a very straightforward process for my coloring via application of some Rub'n Buff Antique Gold wax for the Xenomorph, and Brass color for the base. Wear gloves and apply the wax to a towel and gently go over the details. Avoid pressing really hard so that the void remain black/dark, this helps with final contrast of the model. As you can tell from these two photos the difference between the plain model and the colored one is pretty phenomenal and I HIGHLY recommend going through the effort!

Este modelo paramétrico te permite combinar una inicial grande de base con un nombre superpuesto en relieve , ajustando fuentes, tamaños, enganches y la profundidad de los colores. 🎛️ Guía de Parámetros (Customizer) Para ajustar el llavero a tu gusto, modifica los siguientes parámetros desde la web de MakerWorld: 🔤 [Texto y Fuentes] letra_base : La letra o inicial principal que servirá de cuerpo base para el llavero (Ej: "A") . texto_superpuesto : El nombre o palabra completa que irá grabado sobre la letra base (Ej: "Alicia") . fuente_base : Tipo de fuente para la letra grande. Debe estar instalada en tu sistema o soportada en línea. fuente_texto : Tipo de fuente para el nombre superpuesto (puedes incluir variantes como :style=Bold). 📏 [Dimensiones y Alturas] tamano_letra_base : Tamaño (en mm) de la letra inicial. tamano_texto : Tamaño (en mm) del nombre superpuesto. altura_base : Grosor o altura del cuerpo principal del llavero (Eje Z). altura_offset : Altura extra que sobresale la silueta/borde del texto por encima de la base. Si la pones en 0, el fondo del texto quedará a ras de la base. altura_texto : Grosor o altura de relieve que sobresale el nombre superpuesto por encima de su fondo/offset. 📍 [Posición y Rotación del Texto] offset_x : Desplaza el nombre superpuesto de izquierda a derecha en el plano horizontal. offset_y : Desplaza el nombre superpuesto de arriba a abajo en el plano vertical. rotacion_texto : Grados de rotación del nombre (ej. 0 para horizontal, 90 para vertical). 🎨 [Colores] (Visualización en Render) Nota: Estos colores ayudan a previsualizar la separación de materiales en el diseñador antes de enviar el archivo .3mf o .stl a tu laminador. color_letra_base : Color asignado a la inicial gigante. color_extension_offset : Color del relleno interno del fondo del texto si se incrusta dentro de la base. color_offset : Color del borde o silueta en relieve alrededor del texto. color_extension_texto : Color de la estructura interna del texto si atraviesa la base. color_texto : Color de las letras del nombre superior. 🛡️ [Opciones de Offset / Soporte] activar_offset : true: Añade una silueta/soporte detrás del texto para que no quede flotando si las letras no están unidas. false: Muestra únicamente las letras flotantes del nombre. offset_hasta_base : true: El bloque del fondo atraviesa toda la base hasta tocar el suelo (Z=0), ideal para cambios de color por purga directa en la primera capa. false: El fondo del texto descansa sobre la superficie de la inicial. ancho_offset : Grosor (en mm) del contorno que rodea al nombre superpuesto. ✏️ [Opciones de Texto] texto_hasta_base : true: El texto incrustado atraviesa la pieza por completo desde el suelo (Z=0), permitiendo incrustaciones de color de texto completo en la base. false: El texto solo existe en las capas superiores. 🔑 [Configuración del Enganche / Llavero] tipo_enganche : "anilla": Añade una orejeta o anilla redonda exterior a la base. "agujero": Perfora un orificio directo dentro del cuerpo de la inicial. pos_enganche_x : Posición horizontal (Eje X) de la anilla o agujero. pos_enganche_y : Posición vertical (Eje Y) de la anilla o agujero. diametro_agujero : Diámetro interior del orificio para pasar la argolla metálica. grosor_pared_anilla : Grosor del borde de plástico de la anilla externa.

description: Ethereon – Der Geist von Sparta Nicht jeder Krieger findet nach seinem Tod Frieden. Einst war Ethereon einer der mächtigsten Spartaner seiner Zeit. Unzählige Schlachten kämpfte er für sein Volk, bis er schließlich auf dem Schlachtfeld fiel. Doch sein Wille war stärker als der Tod selbst. Die Legende erzählt, dass seine Seele von den Göttern zurückgerufen wurde, um über die gefallenen Helden zu wachen. Seitdem wandert Ethereon zwischen den Welten – halb Krieger, halb Geist. Sein zerfetzter Umhang weht in einem Wind, den niemand spüren kann, während sein Schild die Seelen der Gerechten beschützt und sein Schwert jene bestraft, die die Ehre verraten. Man sagt, wer ihm in einer dunklen Nacht begegnet, hört das ferne Echo marschierender Soldaten und das Klirren alter Waffen. Doch bevor man ihn erkennen kann, ist er bereits wieder im Nebel verschwunden. Ethereon ist kein Held und kein Monster. Er ist die letzte Wache Spartas. Full description Recreate one of science fiction’s most recognisable display pieces with this detailed Han Solo in Carbonite model. The design features Han Solo captured in raised relief within a textured carbonite surface. The surrounding industrial frame includes mechanical control boxes, pipes, vents and panel details that give the model depth from every viewing angle. Display it vertically as wall art, place it on a shelf, or incorporate it into a science-fiction diorama. The model can be printed in a single colour for a clean sculpted appearance or hand-painted using gunmetal, silver dry-brushing, blue-grey shading and coloured control-panel details. This is a 20" tall, highly detailed, multi-piece print. Please note that the print profile is SINGLE COLOR ONLY. The coloring of the model was achieved in post-process application of coloring wax, as well as acrylic paints applied via air brush. This is not your typical AI colored model, this is truly what this could look like! I only spent 30 minutes on mine! The model prints in several pieces in order to maximize the build volumes of the P and X series machines. Some gluing is required. ASSEMBLY Assembly of the model is very straightfoward - first glue the upper torso to the lower body, and then test fit the arms. The arms stay in place pretty good, and I highly recommend waiting to glue the arms/shield on until after you're doing with painting just so you can have better access. Once the modle is painted, just add a drop of glue on each joing and press them into place. Wait to glue the arrows into their respective holes until the end of the process. COLOR APPLICATION I used a very straightforward process for my coloring via application of some Rub'n Buff waxes - Antique Gold, Copper, Brass, etc. Below is an example of this application process on my Alien model I posted earlier. I simply use a microfiber towel, wear gloves, dab a bit of the Rub'n Buff (I buy mine on amazon) and lightly spread it on the model. For this particular model I could have stopped at the first Bronze look.. but I decided to try out some acrylic paints and see what I can do to really bring it to life. After about 20 minutes of spraying this was the end result! I use really cheap, hobby store acrylic paints that are water based. I dilute them with distilled water to make them sprayable. Clean up is a breeze, and so far I have been loving the color effects. As a finishing step, I applied to Matte Clear Coat to the model. The Before and After really give you a good idea of just a little added effort can REALLY make for an awesome print!

description: Turn simple tiles into sculpted surfaces. TileMaker is a fully parametric OpenSCAD generator for decorative relief tiles, wall panels, plaques, inserts, sensory surfaces, and more. Eight procedural pattern families, extensive shaping controls, pattern blending, edge fading, and seed-based variation make it possible to create everything from refined repeating textures to distinctive, sculpted surfaces. Click on Customize to open the generator. 🚀 Quick Start 1. Define Your Tile Set the width, length, base thickness, and corner rounding. Use zero rounding for a rectangular panel or full rounding for a circle or capsule. 2. Choose a Pattern Choose one of eight procedural surfaces: Ocean – layered swells and cross waves Waves – clean repeating ridges Ripple – concentric impact rings Foam – rounded cellular forms Topographic – warped contour ridges Dunes – wind-shaped ridges and fine ripples Organic – soft flowing structures Labyrinth – winding paths with optional branches Change Pattern Seed to explore new variations. Fine-tune the result with each pattern's dedicated controls. 3. Shape and Blend Adjust the pattern height, soften the perimeter with a fade, or blend in a second pattern globally, across a feathered split, or through a radial transition. 4. Prepare the Print Use a coarse Resolution while designing and a lower value for the final mesh. Export flat for maximum bed contact, or enable Print Upright for smoother relief slopes (recommended). A brim helps upright tiles stay secure on the build plate. ⭐ Features Endless Possibilities Combine seeds, pattern controls, blending, rotation, and tile shaping to create distinctive, one-of-a-kind surfaces. Flexible Tile Shapes Create rectangular panels, rounded tiles, circular medallions, and capsule-shaped plaques. Pattern Blending Combine two patterns globally, across a feathered split, or through a radial transition. Seamless and Edge-Aware Surfaces Generate repeating tiles or soften the relief toward the perimeter with outline-aware fading. 3D Printing Ready Adjust mesh resolution and export tiles flat or upright for cleaner, printable results. ℹ️ Notes For guidance, tips, and troubleshooting, see the Frequently Asked Questions attached to this post. description: Odysseus & the Siren's Song ⚓ — this bizarre, mind-bending tale from Greek mythology has always left a deep impression. To capture that eerie, atmospheric sunset, I modeled this Layered Shadow Box with a striking high-contrast teal and orange color scheme 🌅. Once printed, it takes just 1 second to snap it in seamlessly. The warm light radiating from behind instantly breathes life into the sunset! 🔥 🛠️ 2. Print & Assembly 📱 Mobile Printing: Aside from 3 dual-color plates (recommended for the premium look), all are single-color plates. The plates are perfectly organized so you can easily print them directly from the mobile app (Bambu Handy) with one click. ⚙️ Slicer Settings: If you are unsure about filament settings, simply using the Generic profile will work flawlessly. The default 0.2 mm layer height works great, but for finer details, 0.16 mm or 0.12 mm is recommended (I printed my test model at 0.16 mm). 🧩 Snap-Fit Design: Built-in precision alignment slots allow you to just snap them together. Glue-free assembly by default — just add a tiny drop of glue on the corners if you want ultimate stability. 🏷️ Manual Color Change (No AMS Needed): No AMS? No problem! You can still print a dual-color nameplate. Since the logo text is extremely fine, this specific plate must be sliced using the default 0.08 mm layer height (resulting in 35 layers total). Simply add a "Pause" after Layer 24 finishes (before Layer 25 begins) to manually swap your filament, and you'll get a beautifully crisp, 3D dual-color nameplate! 🎨 3. Colors & Filaments 🌟 Premium Dual-Color Settings To pursue the ultimate color effect, we suggest printing the following 3 plates in dual-color: • 1️⃣ Sun & Cloud Shadows: Frame (Black) + Clouds (Black) + Sun (Warm Orange). • 2️⃣ Sirens & Near Shadows: Frame (Grey) + Clouds (Grey) + Sirens (Silver). • 3️⃣ Ship & Waves: Frame (Teal) + Waves (Teal) + Ship (Coffee Gold). 💡 Minimalist Alternative Short on filament colors? No worries! You can choose this hassle-free minimalist alternative: print all frames in Black, and use White or Grey for all light-and-shadow layers. It will still yield a spectacular, high-contrast result! 🧩 4. Assembly & Snap-Fit 100% Snap-fit assembly with ZERO screws or hardware needed! description: F1 - Redbull Racing RB20 - 1/12 Scale model! Next on my list is this my take on Redbull's RB20 F1 Car done in 1/12 scale! The main idea behind this model was to try and (finally) make a model with some spinning wheels. I had a bunch of 608 bearings from an old project and models this size/wheels around it. The car body is split into 3 pieces to fit the X/P series machines. The wheels and wheel covers print separately. Gluing is required. Size This is a 1/12th scale model Assembly Assembly is straightfoward. The body of the car has hex pegs and needs to be glued. I use Contact Adhesive but any glue will work. The only thing to watchout for is to make sure that your body is perfectly aligned, or your wheels won't sit square across all 4 corners. While the body is drying, take your 608 bearings and press them into the wheel/tire. With that done, install the wheels onto the body (paying attention to which is the front and rear) by pressing the bearing onto the stub shaft. The fit should be somewhat snug, but not too tight. If you are having issues sliding the wheel on, I recommed sanding the wheel stud around just a bit to smooth it out. With the wheels pressed onto the body, proceed to install the retainer washer by pressing it onto the shaft. Don't press it too tight against the wheel or it will prevent free wheel spin. If you want added assurance that this stays in place, you can add a dab of glue to the washer/stubshaft, but it will make it impossible to remove later. With the wheel retainers installed, proceed to press in the covers (again paying attention to the front/rear as they are different). You're done! Only thing left is to paint it you want to go an extra step!

Key Risk: Exothermic polymerization (rapid heat generation) if spilled on clothing, particularly cotton or wool. Before any work begins, ensure the following PPE is worn: Gloves: Nitrile or polyethylene gloves. Do not wear cotton or fabric gloves, as they react violently with cyanoacrylate. Eye Protection: Safety goggles or glasses. Ventilation: Use only in well-ventilated areas to avoid inhaling excessive vapours. Emergency Response & First Aid Skin Bonding: Do not pull the skin apart. Immerse in warm, soapy water or apply acetone to penetrate the bond, then peel gently with a blunt edge. Eye Contact: Do not force eyes open. Flush immediately with warm water or apply a moist gauze patch, and seek immediate medical attention. Spillages: Do not use cloth rags for cleaning. The Legendary Golden Apple🍎✨ A timeless symbol of beauty, temptation, and destiny. The next project is inspired by one of the most iconic stories of Greek mythology . This elegant sculpture features the Legendary Golden Apple , resting upon a classic marble pedestal reminiscent of ancient Greek architecture. Printed in only two colors , the model combines an impressive appearance with an easy printing experience. The complete sculpture finishes in around 4 hours , and although supports are required, they are carefully designed to be easy to remove , leaving behind a beautiful and highly detailed result that truly stands out on display. Whether you're a fan of mythology, classical art, or simply enjoy elegant display pieces, this sculpture brings one of history's greatest legends into your home. 🍎 The Mythology Behind the Golden Apple In Greek mythology , the Golden Apple is one of the most enduring symbols of beauty, pride, and destiny . The story begins when Eris , the goddess of discord, was deliberately excluded from the wedding of Peleus and Thetis . Seeking revenge, she cast a magnificent golden apple among the guests, bearing the famous inscription: "To the Fairest." The simple inscription ignited a bitter rivalry between three powerful goddesses: 👑 Hera , Queen of the Gods ⚔️ Athena , Goddess of Wisdom and War ❤️ Aphrodite , Goddess of Love and Beauty Unable to settle the dispute, Zeus appointed the Trojan prince Paris to choose the rightful owner of the apple. Each goddess attempted to sway his decision with an extraordinary promise. Hera offered limitless power and kingdoms, Athena promised unmatched wisdom and victory in battle, while Aphrodite tempted him with the love of the most beautiful woman in the world— Helen of Sparta . Paris chose Aphrodite. His decision became known as The Judgment of Paris , a single choice that ultimately led to Helen leaving Sparta and ignited the legendary Trojan War . From that day forward, the Golden Apple became far more than a prize for beauty. It evolved into a timeless symbol of temptation, vanity, rivalry, and the unforeseen consequences that can arise from a single decision. 🎨 My Artistic Interpretation This sculpture goes beyond the classical myth. Rather than depicting only the Golden Apple, it merges three powerful symbols into one artistic composition: 🍎 The Golden Apple — beauty, desire, and destiny. 🐍 The Serpent — temptation, persuasion, and hidden consequences. 👤 The Emerging Woman's Face — beauty itself, capable of inspiring both admiration and obsession. Cracks spread across the apple's surface, reminding us that even the most flawless object can hide the seeds of conflict. Together these elements transform an ancient myth into a universal story about human nature—our ambitions, our desires, and the difficult choices that define history. 🍎 Symbolism & Analogy The apple is far more than a fruit—it becomes a vessel for human ambition. Its polished golden surface radiates perfection, yet beneath that beauty lie subtle fractures, reminding us that perfection often comes at a hidden cost. The serpent does not simply guard the apple. It represents temptation itself, quietly whispering that every irresistible desire demands a sacrifice. The woman's face emerging from within the fruit embodies timeless beauty—captivating enough to influence kings, heroes, and entire civilizations. Yet the growing cracks reveal an enduring truth: Beauty can inspire greatness, but when mixed with vanity, envy, and pride, it can divide kingdoms and change the course of history. Like the legendary Golden Apple itself, this sculpture reminds us that a single decision—one moment of temptation or one choice driven by desire—can create consequences that echo for generations.

description: JOHTO League Display – Game Boy Cartridge - Pokémon Gen 2 I've seen similar shadow boxes made with high-quality paper prints, but since my 3D printer is the only machine I have that can go bigger than standard A4 paper, I decided to build my own custom insert for the IKEA SANNAHED frame. Designed specifically for Pokémon Gen 2 Game Boy / Game Boy Color cartridges , this display features dedicated slots for the games and the 8 iconic Johto gym badges. 📐 Project Overview & Features Total Dimensions: 250x250 mm (utilizes the maximum build plate area). Multi-color Display: 5 colors total. It can be printed with 1 single AMS unit (or via manual filament changes). Interchangeable Badges: Features precise recessed areas to insert real enamel pins or future 3D-printed badges. ⚙️ Print & Assembly Guide (Plate by Plate) Plate 1: The Main Display (230x230 mm) Print Orientation: Highly recommended to print Face Down on the build plate (textured or smooth PEI) to achieve a flawless, smooth finish on the front artwork. Important: Do not move or modify the prime tower (purge tower). Its default position is optimized to ensure a safe print without collisions. Plate 2: Invisible Cartridge Holders Includes 3 custom brackets designed for Game Boy and Game Boy Color cartridges. Assembly: Glue them directly under the Pokémon silhouettes using superglue. The Design Trick: They are completely hidden when a game is inserted! The colorful Pokémon silhouettes only reveal themselves when you remove a cartridge to play. Plate 3 & STL: Cutter Blocker, STL : Ground Layer & Border (250x250 mm) ⚠️ IMPORTANT BAMBU LAB TWEAK (P1P / P1S / X1C): To print the large 250x250 mm Border and Ground Layer , you must bypass the default 18mm "no-print zone" dedicated to the filament cutter. Print the small Cutter Blocker wedge included on Plate 3. Clip it onto your printer's toolhead following the official guide: Bambu Lab Wiki - Printable cutter blocker . Now - Download STL : Border & GroundLayer Illustration : In Bambu Studio, change your printer settings to clear the exclusion zone and unlock the full 250x250 mm print bed area. Illustration : Delete “ 0x0, 18x0, 18x28, 0x28 ” and save your setting in a new profile. 🛠️ Final Assembly Instructions Take the white Ground Layer and glue the black Border around it. Center the multi-color Display panel inside the border and secure it with a few drops of superglue. Glue the 3 Cartridge Holders in their designated spots under the Pokémon silhouettes. Insert your games, clip your badges ( Easily found on Amazon and AliExpress) , and enjoy your ultimate retro-gaming display! _____________________________ J'avais vu passer des projets similaires réalisés avec des impressions papier haute qualité, mais n'ayant pas d'imprimante grand format à la maison, mon imprimante 3D était la seule machine capable de dépasser le format A4. Je me suis donc mis en tête de concevoir mon propre cadre sur mesure, parfaitement adapté au modèle IKEA SANNAHED . C'est le moyen idéal pour exposer mes jeux d'enfance et y jouer comme un bon vieux trentenaire ! Je suis à votre écoute pour toute amélioration, et restez à l'affût : les futures générations (Gén 3 et suivantes) arrivent bientôt ! :) Affichez fièrement votre collection Pokémon avec ce cadre vitrine imprimé en 3D ! Conçu spécialement pour accueillir les cartouches Game Boy / Game Boy Color de la Génération 2 ainsi que les 8 badges officiels de Johto. 📐 Caractéristiques du Projet Dimensions totales : 250x250 mm (optimisation maximale du plateau). Impression Multicouleur : 5 couleurs au total. Imprimable avec 1 seul AMS (ou avec changements de filaments manuels). Emplacements Badges : Pensés pour y insérer de vrais pins en émail ou de futurs badges imprimés en 3D. ⚙️ Guide d'Impression (Plateau par Plateau) Plateau 1 : Le Display Principal (230x230 mm) Orientation : À imprimer impérativement face contre le plateau pour obtenir une finition de surface ultra propre et nette à l'avant. Note importante : Ne pas déplacer la tour de purge positionnée sur le côté afin de ne pas gêner le déplacement de la tête d'impression. Plateau 2 : Les Supports de Cartouches Invisibles Contient les 3 supports pour cartouches Game Boy et Game Boy Color. Montage : À coller juste en dessous des silhouettes des Pokémon. L'astuce : Ils sont totalement masqués quand le jeu est en place. Le Pokémon coloré n'apparaît magiquement que lorsque vous retirez la cartouche pour y jouer ! Plateaux 3 et 4 : Bloqueur de Cutter, Ground Layer & Cadre (250x250 mm) ⚠️ PARAMÈTRE BAMBU LAB CRITIQUE (P1P / P1S / X1C) : Pour imprimer le grand cadre de 250x250 mm, vous devez libérer la zone de non-impression habituellement réservée à la découpe du filament. Imprimez la petite pièce pour bloquer le cutter sur le Plateau 3. Installez-la sur la tête d'impression en suivant le guide officiel : Bambu Lab Wiki - Printable cutter blocker . Maintenant - Téléchargez les STL : Border & GroundLayer Illustration : Dans Bambu Studio, modifiez les paramètres de votre imprimante pour désactiver la zone d'exclusion et profiter de toute la surface de 250x250mm. Illustration : Supprimez “ 0x0, 18x0, 18x28, 0x28 ” et sauvegardez sous un nouveau profil. 🛠️ Instructions d'Assemblage Final Prenez le fond blanc ( Ground Layer ) et collez le cadre noir ( Border ) tout autour. Centrez le Display multicolore à l'intérieur et fixez-le à la superglue. Collez les 3 supports de cartouches à leurs emplacements dédiés. Installez vos jeux, vos badges (Trouvable sur Amazon ou AliExpress) , et admirez le résultat !

La scultura è una potente metafora dell'idea che una persona possa plasmare il proprio destino, carattere e futuro attraverso la propria forza, determinazione e duro lavoro. Simboleggia l'autosufficienza e la resilienza. Può essere regalata ad una persona per una spinta motivazionale ad esempio se deve superare un esame, una prova della vita, un piano di allenamento o di dimagrimento. Infatti ho volutamente inserito la frase “NEVER GIVE UP”, per non arrendersi mai, non mollare mai. Ho utilizzato PLA argento (i colori si possono cambiare dallo slicer). Se usate filamenti SILK impostate bene i parametri per quel tipo di filamento (si sa che i filamenti silk vanno tarati e calibrati bene). Lo scrivo perché per la versione maschile, nonostante avessi stampato bene e senza alcun problema tanti modelli, qualche utente ha avuto problemi con i supporti perché aveva usato il filamento silk non calibrato bene e mi ha messo una recensione non buona (a scanso di equivoci, per questo modello, metto le foto dalle quali si evince che i supporti sono buoni e non danno problemi). I supporti si staccano facilmente vedrete. Prendete il modello stampato in mano e tirate delicatamente i supporti verso il basso per staccarli . Il testo è strutturato su 3 righe, quindi ci sono 3 oggetti diversi come text: Text Never Text Give Text Up. Se non volete il testo basta andare in oggetti, cliccare col tasto destro del mouse su tutti e 3 i Text e selezionare elimina. In alternativa potete modificare il testo a proprio piacimento, ( consiglio di non modificare i parametri del testo tra cui dimensione e spessore. Tenete quelli della foto seguente ). CONSIGLI GENERALI Un consiglio che dispenso sempre è quello di pulire preliminarmente il piatto di stampa con detersivo per piatti ed una spugnetta risciacquando con acqua calda, dopodiché asciugarlo con aria compressa evitando di toccare la superficie con le mani. Inoltre consiglio di fare le calibrazioni del flusso dinamico e del flaw rate previste in bambu studio. Personalmente prima delle stampe asciugo il PLA con AMS 2 PRO per circa 1 oretta. Sono questi piccoli accorgimenti, insieme a tanti altri, che determinano la riuscita di una bella stampa. Prima di mettere giudizi negativi, cortesemente regolate questi parametri. Se avete difficoltà o continuate a riscontrare problemi non esitate a contattarmi, cerchiamo insieme le soluzioni in un perfetto clima collaborativo. Ho fatto diverse stampe di questo oggetto e sono venute tutte perfette come in foto: se avete parametri sballati, nozzle sporchi o intasati, macchine calibrate male, filamenti umidi o di cattiva qualità non ve la prendete con me. description: FULLY ARTICULATED or FLEXI, Glow In The Dark Anglerfish Detailed Description of the Model Bring the deep ocean trenches right to your desk with this fully articulated, print-in-place Anglerfish model! Designed with intricate textural scales, razor-sharp teeth, and its iconic illuminated lure, this model features zero assembly and requires no supports. It prints entirely as one piece with fluid, snaking articulation across its body segments, allowing it to slither and pose naturally. To achieve that authentic bioluminescent deep-sea look, print it using TECBEARS PLA Glow in The Dark (Luminous) 3D Printer Filament . Because glow-in-the-dark filaments contain abrasive phosphorescent particles, we highly recommend pairing your setup with SUNLU PLA Glow in the Dark Filament or using a hardened steel nozzle to prevent premature wear. How It's Used & Functional Applications Fidget & Desk Toy: The multi-segment flexible spine makes for an incredible sensory fidget toy that relieves stress and looks striking resting on any shelf or monitor stand. Nighttime Display: Charge the filament under a bright light or UV source to watch the deep-sea predator cast an eerie, glowing green light in a dark room. History & Background Anglerfish are famous inhabitants of the aphotic zone of the ocean—the pitch-black depths of the sea where sunlight never reaches. Using a modified fin ray acting as a glowing bioluminescent lure (the esca) to attract unsuspecting prey, these creatures represent some of the most fascinating evolutionary traits in marine biology. This 3D model captures that natural wonder, translating deep-sea mythology into a modern mechanical print-in-place design. Alternative Uses & Remixing Ideas Aquarium Decor: Scale up the print and seal it with safe coatings to use as an eye-catching centerpiece for a themed freshwater or faux-aquarium setup. Halloween & Spooky Decor: Perfect for haunted house props, gothic table centerpieces, or spooky seasonal displays. description: 2" Virgin Mary Concrete Casting Mold Create a beautiful, 12-inch tall statue of the Virgin Mary with this custom-designed, multi-part 3D printable mold. This project is designed for those who enjoy the challenge of high-quality concrete casting and want to produce professional-looking results at home. Project Overview This mold is comprised of 8 distinct parts, engineered to lock together to create a seamless casting cavity. The intricate details on the inner faces are designed to capture the delicate features and flowing fabric textures of the statue perfectly. Instructions for Casting The process for using this mold requires patience and attention to detail: Printing: Print all 8 segments of the mold. For the best results, I recommend using SUNLU PLA+ Filament , which provides the durability and surface finish needed for intricate molds. Assembly: Connect the printed parts using clips and rubber bands to ensure they are held tightly in place during the pour. No glue is required for this assembly. Concrete Preparation: Select a high-quality concrete mix. Crucially, you must sift out ALL large rocks from the mix to ensure a smooth, detailed surface. Pouring: Add water according to the manufacturer’s instructions and carefully fill the assembled mold. Setting: Allow the concrete to set for the full recommended time specified by the manufacturer. Removal: Once set, place the mold in an oven at a low temperature to slowly and carefully melt the 3D-printed pieces away, revealing your finished statue. Remixing and Applications This design can be adapted for various purposes beyond religious decor: Garden Art: Scale up or down for custom garden accents. Custom Plaster Casting: Use the same mold with plaster of Paris for indoor display pieces. Abstract Sculpture: The modular nature of the 8-part system allows for creative re-orientation to produce abstract, geometric concrete art. description: Chairs of the Past — 1:12 Miniature Series Chairs of the Past brings unusual, historic, and sometimes wonderfully peculiar chair designs back to life as printable 1:12 miniatures. Each model begins with an old engraving or documented chair from another era, then is carefully interpreted as a three-dimensional object suitable for a dollhouse, miniature room, display, or historical scene. Some chairs are elegant, some practical, and others hide surprising stories—but every one offers a small glimpse into how people once sat, worked, rested, and lived. Tennyson Armchair The Tennyson chair is an elegant cane-seated study armchair with a tall arched back, slender turned uprights, and gracefully scrolling arms. Its light, refined construction gives it a more polished and decorative appearance than many of the heavier historic chairs in the series, while the shaped front rail and small hanging pendant details add a touch of Gothic character. This chair was associated with Alfred, Lord Tennyson, and was described as a modern French-type cane-bottomed study chair. The original was sketched in the poet’s study at Haslemere, where it stood near his writing table. That connection gives the chair a quiet literary presence, while its refined silhouette makes it especially appealing as a miniature furnishing. In 1:12 scale, the Tennyson chair would work especially well in: • a study or writing room • a library • a parlour • a literary interior • any miniature setting needing an elegant antique armchair Its open back, cane seat, and decorative details also make it an appealing piece for painted finishes, wood-toning, and fine miniature display work. How I Established the 1:12 Dollhouse Scale The image below shows how I estimated the final 1:12 scale dimensions for this model. I use an image editing application called Pixelmator Pro, but most image editing programs should work. The process is simple: I place the model image into a Victorian room reference image where the back wall has been set to 254 mm high. At 1:12 scale, 254 mm represents a 10-foot ceiling. Once the wall height is set, I resize the model image until it looks correct inside the room. The image editing application then gives me the approximate width and height of the model. I use those measurements as the starting point in my slicer and adjust the 3D model to match. This method helps me scale the model visually, rather than guessing from numbers alone. Important: The wall image must be set to exactly 254 mm high. The width will adjust automatically once the height is set. I have included the wall image near the bottom of this description, after the Buy Me a Coffee notice, so you can download it and use the same method to help scale models for your own 1:12 dollhouse. This is not a precision engineering method, but it is a very useful visual guide for dollhouse room scale. Bambu Settings for this Model For those of you who want the model but in a different scale: Here is the Victorian wall image for you to download and use as a simple 1:12 scale reference. Set the height of this wall image to 254 mm in your image editing application. That represents a 10-foot wall at 1:12 scale. Then import the image of the model you want to scale and place it into the room. Resize the model image until it looks correct visually. Record the model’s height and width from your image application, then use those measurements as a starting point in your slicer. That’s it. This is not a precision engineering method, but it is a very useful visual guide for checking dollhouse scale. 😊 [End]

Its cheerful expression works well as a small birthday gift, a desk surprise or a cozy addition to a bedroom. Tiny Yawn Cat looks beautiful in many different colors. Soft grey, beige, cream or brown can create a calm and natural look. Pastel shades make the character even sweeter, while bright colors give it a more playful personality. The raised paw and visible toe beans can also become a fun focal point when displayed from the front. Pair this sleepy kitty with sitting, stretching, waving or relaxing cats to build a collection filled with different moods and personalities. Each cat can tell its own small story while still looking like part of the same adorable family. With its big yawn, tiny paws and completely relaxed attitude, Tiny Yawn Cat is ready to bring comfort, humor and a little sleepy happiness into your space. Eye Protection: Safety goggles or glasses. Ventilation: Use only in well-ventilated areas to avoid inhaling excessive vapours. Emergency Response & First Aid Skin Bonding: Do not pull the skin apart. Immerse in warm, soapy water or apply acetone to penetrate the bond, then peel gently with a blunt edge. Eye Contact: Do not force eyes open. Flush immediately with warm water or apply a moist gauze patch, and seek immediate medical attention. Spillages: Do not use cloth rags for cleaning. Chicago Screw Paramétrico com Rosca Real — OpenSCAD Gerador paramétrico de Chicago Screws (parafuso macho + poste fêmea) desenvolvido em OpenSCAD e otimizado para fabricação por impressão 3D. O modelo utiliza a biblioteca BOSL2 para gerar roscas helicoidais reais, permitindo que as duas peças sejam impressas separadamente e posteriormente rosqueadas entre si. Todas as principais dimensões podem ser ajustadas diretamente nos parâmetros do arquivo, permitindo criar conjuntos personalizados para diferentes espessuras, aplicações e tolerâncias de impressão. Características Conjunto completo com peça macho e peça fêmea. Rosca interna e externa geometricamente modeladas. Dimensões totalmente parametrizáveis. Comprimento do poste configurável. Diâmetro externo do poste configurável. Diâmetros superior e inferior da cabeça configuráveis. Espessura da cabeça configurável. Diâmetro e passo da rosca configuráveis. Fenda para chave de fenda. Controle de tolerância entre as roscas através do $slop. Geometria preparada para impressão 3D. Visualização automática das duas peças lado a lado no OpenSCAD. Dependência Este projeto utiliza a biblioteca BOSL2 — Belfry OpenSCAD Library . BOSL2 deve estar instalada na pasta de bibliotecas do OpenSCAD ou disponível junto ao projeto. Parâmetros principais post_length Define o comprimento útil do poste fêmea. post_outer_d Define o diâmetro externo do poste. head_d_s Define o diâmetro superior da cabeça. head_d_i Define o diâmetro inferior da cabeça. head_thickness Define a espessura da cabeça. thread_d Define o diâmetro nominal da rosca. pitch Define o passo entre os filetes da rosca. slot_width Define a largura da fenda para chave de fenda. slot_depth Define a profundidade da fenda. $slop Controla a folga entre a rosca interna e externa, sendo especialmente útil para compensar as tolerâncias da impressão 3D. Ajuste para impressão 3D O valor de $slop é um dos parâmetros mais importantes para garantir que o parafuso e o poste possam ser rosqueados após a impressão. O valor padrão utilizado no projeto é: $slop = 0.15 Dependendo da impressora, material, diâmetro do bico e calibração de fluxo, pode ser necessário aumentar ou reduzir esse valor. Como referência inicial: menor folga: aproximadamente 0.10 folga padrão: aproximadamente 0.15 maior folga: aproximadamente 0.20 Recomenda-se realizar um pequeno teste de rosca antes de produzir peças maiores ou múltiplas unidades. Configuração padrão do modelo O conjunto fornecido utiliza aproximadamente: Poste fêmea: 14 mm Diâmetro externo do poste: 6 mm Rosca: 3 mm Passo: 0,6 mm Cabeça: aproximadamente 8–10 mm Espessura da cabeça: 0,8 mm O parafuso macho possui comprimento calculado proporcionalmente ao comprimento do poste. Aplicações O modelo pode ser utilizado em projetos como: encadernação; trabalhos em couro; bolsas e acessórios; caixas e estojos; peças decorativas; montagem de placas; projetos maker; protótipos; pequenas uniões desmontáveis. Observação O modelo foi projetado principalmente para impressão 3D FDM . Roscas pequenas são bastante sensíveis à calibração da impressora, largura de linha, fluxo, altura de camada e características do filamento. Para roscas próximas de 3 mm, recomenda-se utilizar boa resolução de camada e realizar testes de tolerância antes da produção definitiva.

description: Create a custom print-in-place chain in the length and style you want. ChainMaker is a fully parametric OpenSCAD generator for classic interlocking chains and sculpted Cuban chains. Choose a target length or link count, customize the link geometry, and arrange the chain to suit your build plate. Smart sizing, layout, spacing, and validation systems handle the technical work behind the scenes, so you can focus on designing the chain instead of constructing it. Click Customize to open the generator. 🚀 Quick Start 1. Choose the Chain Select Classic for alternating interlocking links or Cuban for smooth, flattened links. Set a target stretched length, enter a manual link count, and resize the complete design with Link Scale . 2. Choose the Layout Arrange the chain as a Closed Loop , Closed Snake , Straight line, or compact Spiral . Use Print Spacing to control the distance between neighboring links, and adjust the bend or layout-specific settings when needed. 3. Customize the Links Classic links support rounded or chamfered paths, multiple profiles, profile twist, thickness, and interlocking angle. Cuban links provide control over radii, thickness, Bezier shaping, and face flattening. Enable Connector Link to open one end link for attachments or reconnecting the chain. Enable Debug to view calculated chain and layout information. 4. Preview and Export Inspect the complete layout in your slicer and check that all links remain separate. Once satisfied, export your chain at the desired resolution and print. Have fun! ⭐ Features Two Link Families Create two distinct chain families with one shared sizing and layout system. Smart Length Solving Enter a target length or choose the exact number of links yourself. Flexible Print Layouts Use rounded loops, compact closed snakes, straight chains, or spirals. Measured Diagnostics View solved length, link count, pitch, bend, and layout size. Print-Focused Workflow Tune spacing, test clearances, and export clean printable geometry. 🖨️ Printing Advice Print-in-place chains depend heavily on first-layer accuracy and clearance. Use a brim for small chains with limited build-plate contact. Enable variable layer height for smoother steep curves. Inspect the chain carefully in the slicer. Print the Clearance Test before committing to unfamiliar geometry or materials. ChainMaker uses mathematical spacing, envelope, closure, and bend calculations, but extreme custom shapes should still be checked visually before printing. Closed chains have no clasp. For wearable designs, make sure it passes over the hand or head, or use an open chain with your own clasp. Integrated functional clasps may be added in a future update if there is enough interest. ℹ️ Notes For additional guidance and troubleshooting, see the Frequently Asked Questions attached to this post. Feedback and examples of what you create are always welcome. 📜 Maker Scripts

*** Images are actual photographed Prints. This is a fully 3D-printable eyewear design that you can print, finish, and assemble entirely at home. It requires no screws, hinges, or extra hardware—all you need is some super glue and a bit of post-processing to get a clean, functional pair of glasses. This model is designed to support standard and prescription lenses, making it both a stylish accessory and a practical daily wear option. For ordering lenses in the EU: I found Lens4Glasses to be an affordable option that ships across the EU. Important: Please ask your optician not to heat the frame when fitting the lenses. The frame is designed to fit the lenses without heating—and yes, they will deform your eyewear and send it back! 🙂 Key Features Two Sizes Included: Comes in two different sizes to help ensure a proper fit for different face shapes. Lens-Ready: Designed to accommodate both standard non-prescription lenses and prescription lenses. 100% Hardware-Free: No need to source tiny screws or specialized hinges. Easy Assembly: Simple joint design secured with a small amount of super glue. Recommended Print Settings To ensure the best surface finish and structural strength, the following settings are recommended: Layer Height: 0.10mm to 0.15mm (highly recommended for smoother curves and easier sanding) Infill: 40% – 50% Supports: Required. You will need to enable supports for the curved sections of the temples (the arms that go behind the ears). Material Compatibility This model has been tested with several filaments, and you can print it using almost any standard material: Bambu PLA-CF: Highly recommended. The carbon fiber texture provides a premium matte finish and excellent structural rigidity. Wood PLA: Gives a unique, organic aesthetic. It looks great but will require extra sanding and finishing to get a smooth feel. Standard PLA/PETG: Works well and offers a wide range of color choices. Assembly & Post-Processing Sanding: To achieve a comfortable fit and clean look, thoroughly sand the frames and temples. Start with a coarser grit (like 220) to smooth out print lines, and finish with a wet sand (400 to 1000 grit) for a smooth surface. Dry Fit: Test-fit the temples into the frame joints before applying any glue to ensure they align properly. Gluing: Apply a very small drop of super glue (cyanoacrylate) to the connection points. Hold the pieces firmly in place Lens Installation How to install: Standard scanned or custom-cut lenses can be snapped directly into the frame from the inside. Important Note: Do not apply heat (such as hot water or a hairdryer) to the frame during installation. Heating the plastic can cause the printed frame to warp or lose its shape. The lenses are designed to snap into place easily at room temperature.

It condenses the mysterious vitality of the ocean depths into a wearable art piece, breaking the gentle stereotypes of conventional jewelry for ocean lovers and admirers of avant-garde sculptural aesthetics. Crafted as a seamless single-piece print with matte white finish, it retains delicate natural layer textures without polishing or gem inlays, letting the sculptural form speak for itself. The ring face fully sculpts an octopus: its rounded mantle soft and full, eight tentacles coiling fluidly around the band. Every limb is lined with raised textured suckers, curling inward to embrace the ring or spiraling outward freely. The band’s sides are carved with tiny coral textures that recreate seabed reefs, weaving a miniature underwater scene of solid and hollow space. The towering high-relief structure abandons the flatness of ordinary bands, with staggered tentacles forming layered hollow cutouts. Light filters through gaps as you rotate your finger, shifting shadow and brightness to deliver inherent flowing dynamism. The name Abyss Spiral holds layered meaning: “Abyss” evokes the boundless deep sea, standing for a broad, inclusive inner world; “Spiral” references the swirling coiled tentacles, symbolizing cyclical life and quiet, resilient strength. The octopus has long been a symbol of deep-sea intelligence: soft-bodied yet capable of surviving extreme ocean depths, it represents the wearer’s ability to navigate life with flexibility, holding boundless creativity and adaptability within. Tentacles wrapped around the band act as a self-protective barrier, embodying the spirit of self-acceptance and guarding your inner ocean away from noisy external chaos. Moving past sweet, ornate commercial jewelry, Abyss Spiral boasts a cool, gender-neutral sculptural style suitable for all wearers. Its plain white tone complements monochrome office outfits, dark workwear, marine outdoor styling and avant-garde artistic looks. Worn alone, it becomes the focal point of any ensemble; stacked alongside the collection’s manatee and mythological rings, it forms a complete set of nature-inspired sculptural accessories. Hollow construction drastically reduces weight for all-day comfort, while smoothly rounded tentacle edges eliminate sharp points, balancing bold artistic vision with everyday wearability. True luxury never relies on precious stone embellishment—it draws power from the spiritual essence of natural creatures. Abyss Spiral distills the ocean’s silence, flexibility and mystery into a tiny ring. Every lift of your hand carries an undisturbed deep-sea vortex; with soft coiled tentacles, embrace the vast underwater universe that belongs only to you.

description: 骨羁・荒墟（Bone Bond・Desolate Ruin） 骨羁・荒墟白瓷戒指，是暗黑先锋雕塑美学与德化高白瓷烧制工艺碰撞诞生的艺术首饰，打破大众对骷髅配饰冰冷粗粝的固有印象，以温润瓷质重构生死艺术。整件首饰以写实人类颅骨为视觉核心，匠人手工精雕颅骨全部细节，深邃眼窝、立体鼻骨、整齐齿列完整复刻人体骨骼肌理，凹凸起伏精准写实，既还原骨骼原生力量感，又不会带来狰狞压迫感。环绕骷髅的镂空结构由仿生掌骨、指骨交错编织而成，一节节骨节轮廓饱满圆润，骨骼线条纵横交错，层层围合形成牢笼框架，如同肉身羁绊困住灵魂，极具故事氛围感。 主材选用顶级德化羊脂白瓷，历经 1300℃高温多次入窑烧制，瓷胎密度紧实坚硬，抗磕碰、耐磨损，釉面呈现柔和细腻的亮白光泽，没有工业塑料的廉价惨白，触感顺滑温润。镂空是整件作品的灵魂，错落的骨骼缝隙让光线自由穿梭，转动戒指时光影不断流转，骨骼的硬朗线条与白瓷的温润质感形成强烈反差，刚柔平衡恰到好处。戒圈做加厚圆弧打磨，保证结构稳固的同时减轻整体重量，长时间佩戴不会硌压手指，内圈全圆角处理，亲肤顺滑。 设计内核探讨束缚与本我的博弈，交错骨骼象征世俗规则、外界标签层层桎梏，居中骷髅代表最真实的自我，寓意挣脱他人定义，接纳完整的自我，拥有直面本心的勇气。穿搭适配度极强，无论是街头高街、机能工装、哥特暗黑穿搭，还是极简黑白通勤风都可以适配，男女皆可佩戴，风格辨识度独一档。不同于金属骷髅配饰容易氧化发黑、触感冷硬，白瓷性质稳定，防水防汗，常年佩戴依旧莹白干净。全程手工修雕，骨骼缠绕走向没有标准化模板，每一枚纹路都具备独一无二的手工痕迹，兼具穿搭装饰价值与小众收藏属性。它拒绝流水线的千篇一律，把哲学思考藏于指尖方寸，酷感内敛高级，小众不易撞款，既是穿搭点睛配饰，也是承载精神态度的微型雕塑。 Bone Bond · Desolate Ruin white porcelain ring is an artistic jewelry born from the collision of avant-garde dark sculptural aesthetics and Dehua high-white porcelain firing craftsmanship. It subverts people’s stereotype of cold and rough skull accessories, reshaping life-and-death art with tender porcelain texture. Centered on a realistic human skull, the ring is manually carved with exquisite details, including deep eye sockets, three-dimensional nasal bones and neat teeth, perfectly restoring physical bone texture. It retains the primitive power of bones without intimidating ferocity. The hollow frame wrapping the skull is woven by bionic metacarpals and phalanges. The thickened smoothly rounded band ensures structural stability and lightweight comfort, avoiding finger indentation after long wear. Its fully polished inner curve brings skin-friendly experience. The design interprets the game between restriction and inner authenticity. Interlaced bones stand for worldly shackles and external labels, while the central skull symbolizes true self. It encourages wearers to break stereotypes and embrace their whole selves. Unisex and highly versatile, it matches streetwear, techwear, gothic outfits and minimalist daily attires. Unlike metal skull ornaments prone to oxidation and icy touch, porcelain resists sweat and discoloration, keeping milky white permanently. Abandoning repetitive industrial design, it hides profound philosophy on fingertips. description: 棠露・栖枝（Crabapple Dew・Resting Branch） 棠露・栖枝白瓷戒指扎根中式传统花鸟瓷雕文脉，复刻宋代工笔花卉的婉约灵秀，以盛放海棠花为核心，搭配层叠花叶与缠绕枝蔓，把东方春日花鸟意境雕琢于白瓷指环之上，是国风美学与德化瓷雕工艺相融的典藏级配饰。戒身采用不对称开放式镂空雕刻，盛放海棠居于视觉重心，匠人精细雕琢层层舒展的花瓣，花瓣肌理脉络清晰流畅，花蕊颗粒饱满立体，细腻还原真实海棠的柔美形态。四周搭配形态各异的阔叶、嫩芽花苞，藤蔓婉转缠绕、蜿蜒环抱戒圈，花叶排布参照国画留白章法，繁简有度，镂空缝隙错落灵动，让厚重瓷料变得轻盈通透，转动之间光影游走，雕花层次立体生动。 主材选用经过三回施釉、两次高温烧制的德化象牙白瓷，瓷色暖润柔和，是温润的羊脂暖白，无惨白冷硬感，釉面细腻油润，暗光内敛雅致，亮光通透莹润，触感温润如玉。白瓷物理性质稳定，抗氧化、耐酸碱，不惧日常磕碰与汗水侵蚀，长期佩戴不会发黄变乌，相较银饰不易氧化、树脂不易老化，耐用性优势显著。戒圈后半段素面平滑，保障佩戴顺滑，雕花区域所有棱角均手工磨圆，佩戴不会磨手勾衣，兼顾国风繁复美感与日常实用性。 海棠自古有富贵安康、温婉顺遂的吉祥寓意，缠枝花叶代表生生不息的希望，承载花开常伴、岁岁安然的美好祝愿。穿搭适配新中式旗袍、禅意茶服、国风连衣裙，尽显古典温婉；搭配纯色风衣、基础针织、简约通勤装，可打造国风混搭高级感，男女佩戴皆适配。当下很多国风首饰一味堆砌雕花，繁杂拥挤显廉价，此款遵循国画虚实构图，雕花疏密得当，手工雕刻无法机器批量复刻统一纹路，每一片花叶弧度都有细微专属差别，收藏价值远超量产饰品。全程无宝石镶嵌，仅凭瓷雕工艺彰显格调，风格清雅大气，跳出传统国风首饰老气沉闷的弊病。自用尽显不俗审美底蕴，送礼适配女性长辈、闺蜜、爱人，寓意雅致吉祥。将春日海棠繁花定格于指尖，把中式婉约浪漫随身携带，素雅高级，百搭耐看，让古典美学适配现代日常穿搭。 Crabapple Dew · Resting Branch inherits traditional Chinese flower-and-bird porcelain carving and Song meticulous painting elegance. Centered on blooming crabapple matched with layered leaves and twisting branches, it carries oriental spring charm onto white porcelain band, representing premium integration of oriental aesthetics and Dehua carving craft. The ring adopts asymmetric open hollow carving. The fully bloomed crabapple is exquisitely shaped with clear petal veins and plump three-dimensional stamens. Various leaves, buds and winding vines surround the band, arranged by Chinese painting blank-leaving rules. Well-proportioned hollowing makes solid porcelain light and airy, with vivid dynamic shadow changes when rotating. Made of triple-glazed double-fired Dehua ivory porcelain, it delivers warm creamy jade-like whiteness without harsh pale tone. The glossy glaze looks subtle in dim light and translucent under bright light with silky jade touch. Stable porcelain resists oxidation, acid, collision and sweat, avoiding silver oxidation and resin aging for long-term wear. Plain smooth rear band ensures comfort; all carved edges are manually rounded to prevent scratches, combining classic intricacy and daily practicality. Crabapple symbolizes fortune, wellness and gentleness in Chinese culture; winding vines stand for endless vitality, carrying wishes of lasting joy and peace. It matches cheongsam, zen tea robes and Chinese dresses for classic grace, and blends well with windbreakers and knitwear for modern oriental style, suitable for all genders. Many tacky Chinese-style ornaments suffer from messy over-decoration, while this piece follows traditional virtual-real layout. Hand carving cannot be mass-produced mechanically, endowing each ring unique leaf details and high collectibility. With zero gem inlay, its taste relies purely on carving art, refreshing old-fashioned traditional jewelry styles. It reflects refined personal taste for daily wear and serves as auspicious elegant gift for family and partners. Freezing spring crabapple blossoms on fingertips, it brings ancient oriental romance to modern life with timeless elegant versatility.

description: The Dovetail Wallet V2 is a compact EDC wallet that holds up to six cards and uses a spring-loaded trigger to fan them out with one press. It also works with fewer than six cards, so you do not need to carry it completely full. I originally started the Dovetail project as a way to better understand how rack-and-pinion gears work. I’m a fifth-grade teacher, and designing useful things is something I do in my free time. The original wallet received a much bigger response than I expected, so I spent a lot of time rebuilding the design and fixing the parts that could be better. What changed in V2 The trigger mechanism has been redesigned to give the cards a more controlled fan instead of launching them out of the wallet. The trigger tension can be adjusted by tightening or loosening the M3 nut on the gear. A nut-free version is also included and can still be adjusted. A retention mechanism at the top of the wallet keeps the cards secure when the trigger is not being pressed. V2 is a complete redesign and is not compatible with parts from the original wallet. Dovetail rail system The wallet includes a dovetail rail system for custom accessories and future attachments. There are not any official attachments available at launch, but I have included an STL of the dovetail connection so other designers can create their own compatible EDC accessories. I plan to continue adding to the system over time. Current Attachements fount in the print profile: Ferro Rod Money Band Included versions The initial release includes: Topographic cover Blank cover (Faceplate Catalog profile) Standard adjustable version Version that does not require an M3 nut I also plan to add more print profiles and customization options. Printing and assembly Assembly Video The wallet is not print-in-place, but the parts are easy to print and assembly is straightforward. The main profile takes approximately 2 hours and 45 minutes to print. It is designed around: 0.4 mm nozzle AMS PLA, PETG, ABS or ASA My preferred material is ASA because it holds up well to regular use and higher temperatures, such as being left inside a vehicle. The wallet in the cover photo was printed with a smooth PEI plate for the front cover. The back was printed on a Bambu carbon-fiber texture plate. Membership Sell at markets or just show some love! Required hardware 2 × M3 × 8 mm machine screws 2 × M3 × 10 mm machine screws 1 × M3 nut (not essential) 1 × 0.4 × 5 × 15 mm compression spring (not essential) Lubricating oil (not essential) The 0.4 × 5 × 15 mm spring is the size I designed and tested the mechanism around. A separate version is included for anyone who wants to print the wallet without using the M3 nut.

Premium sunglasses case. There are a few varieties to choose from. They by default have fuzzy skin turned on for parts of it to make it look more proffesional. This summer, I went on several trips. I like to take sunglasses, because they're convenient for driving, and we were in the sun a lot. However, (I have four pairs that I took on the trips) I had to store them in a zip up pocket that I hoped would protect them. It didn't sadly. I stored them in there with books, chargers, devices - anything you'd take on a vacation. I opened up the pocket and there my fancy pink aviators were, bent all out of shape. I had to try to bend them back into shape, and even then they fit too loosely on my head. This is designed to completely prevent things like that from happening. Looks good in almost any color. Here's a few instructions: Magnets You need 10 8x2mm round magnets for this, linked below in the BOM. If you don't want to use that much, just put 6 in; two pairs in the corners, and one in the hole closest to the center. Works very well either way. The magnets should friction fit pretty well but if any are too loose just put a drop of superglue. TPU padding. You can optionally print a TPU pad for the lenses to not get scratched. You don't need it, but it is recommended. I have also included a DXF file if you want to lasercut it out of something else, like cork (for looks), felt, foam, etc. If you slice it yourself, don't forget to turn off the top and bottom layers so it is directly cushioned by the infill. I simulated the case getting smashed in a suitcase by, say a laptop corner or just something. I know that it simulates solid PLA instead of printed, so I tested it with a 15mm cube pushing with 500 lbf of force to make completely sure. With that force it deformed by 2.5~mm . Should be completely fine with whatever you're taking it in! If you have any suggestions just comment!

description: Choco Snap – Clicky Chocolate Fidget Keychain A satisfying chocolate-shaped fidget keychain you can print in about an hour. 🍫 Choco Snap is a compact clicky fidget designed around three things: quick printing, low filament usage, and a satisfying mechanical snap. The three chocolate sections move independently, while a piece cut from a steel retractable tape measure blade creates the characteristic clicky action. Add a ball chain and Choco Snap becomes a compact fidget keychain you can carry on your bag, pouch, backpack, or keys. 🎥 Assembly Guide Please watch the assembly guide before preparing the steel tape measure piece or assembling the model. The video shows the complete assembly process, including the placement and orientation of the internal components. Watch the Choco Snap Assembly Guide ✨ Features 🍫 Chocolate-inspired design 🖱️ Satisfying mechanical click and snap ⏱️ Around 1 hour print time 🧵 Low filament usage 🔑 Compact keychain size 🛠️ Simple assembly 🎨 Easy to customize with different colors ♻️ Uses small pieces of 1.75 mm filament as hinge pins 🖨️ Printing Choco Snap was designed to be a quick and lightweight project that doesn't require a large amount of filament. PLA works well for the printed body. Because the model is small, it's a great project when you want something fun and functional without waiting several hours for a print. Actual print time and filament usage may vary depending on: Printer Print profile Layer height Print speed Filament Other slicer settings With an appropriate profile, the complete set of printed parts can be produced in approximately 1 hour . 🔧 Additional Parts Needed In addition to the printed parts, you will need: A piece cut from a steel retractable tape measure blade 1.75 mm filament for the hinge pins A ball chain or another keychain attachment, if desired The steel tape measure piece is a key part of the clicking mechanism and is required for the intended snap action. ⚙️ Important – Click Mechanism The key component of Choco Snap is the steel tape measure piece installed inside the model. Cut a piece from a steel retractable tape measure blade to approximately: 50 mm long × 10–11 mm wide The natural curved shape and elasticity of the steel tape are used to create Choco Snap's characteristic snap movement and clicky feel when the chocolate sections are pressed. After cutting the tape to size, install it inside the printed parts as shown in the assembly guide. The position and orientation of the steel tape piece are important for proper operation. If the click doesn't feel right after assembly, check the placement and orientation of the steel tape first. ⚠️ Cutting the Steel Tape Measure Please take care when preparing the steel tape measure piece. The cut edges of a tape measure blade can be sharp. When cutting it: Use appropriate cutting tools Wear eye protection Keep your hands away from the cutting area Smooth or deburr sharp edges before assembly Do not install the piece while sharp burrs remain on the cut edges. 🔩 Hinge Assembly The three chocolate sections are connected using short pieces of 1.75 mm filament as hinge pins. Cut the filament to the required length and insert it through the hinge holes to connect the sections. Using filament as the hinge pins keeps the assembly simple and eliminates the need for additional metal pins or screws. Basic Assembly Prepare the three printed chocolate sections. Connect the sections using 1.75 mm filament as hinge pins. Install the prepared steel tape measure piece. Check that each section moves smoothly. Test the snapping action. Attach a ball chain if you want to use Choco Snap as a keychain. For the exact assembly method, refer to the video at the top of this page. 🍫 Color Ideas Try printing Choco Snap in different “flavors”: Milk Chocolate Brown White Chocolate Matcha Green Strawberry Pink Dark Chocolate Caramel Or create your own flavor! description: Turn your favorite design into a unique 3D T-shirt 👕🖨️ These thin and flexible 3D prints are designed to be heat-transferred directly onto fabric using a household iron. The result is a durable and eye-catching 3D design that combines modern 3D printing technology with fashion. Instructions 🛠️👕 Download the model and open it in Bambu Studio 💻 Print the model using the recommended settings and carefully remove it from the build plate. ⚠️ Handle with care — the model is extremely thin (approximately 0.3 mm) and may tear or deform if bent too aggressively. Prepare your ironing area: Place the T-shirt on an ironing board or a flat heat-resistant surface. Set your iron to a very high temperature (almost maximum heat, without steam) 🔥 Allow the iron to fully preheat before starting. Position the printed model on the desired area of the T-shirt and cover it with baking/parchment paper 📄 Apply firm pressure with the preheated iron for 15–20 seconds. For larger designs, move the iron slowly and evenly to ensure the entire model receives sufficient heat. Maintain consistent pressure throughout the process. ⏱️ Allow the area to cool for a few seconds, then carefully remove the paper. ✅ The model should remain attached to the fabric while the paper lifts away easily. (Optional) Turn the T-shirt inside out and iron the reverse side of the applied design for an additional 5–10 seconds to improve adhesion. 👕✨ Important ⚠️ Always use the iron at a very high temperature (near maximum setting) and with the steam function turned off. Insufficient heat or pressure may result in poor adhesion to the fabric. Test on a small area first if using delicate or heat-sensitive fabrics. Care Instructions 🧼 Wash garments at temperatures not exceeding 50°C (122°F). Turn the T-shirt inside out before washing whenever possible. Avoid bleach and aggressive washing programs. Do not tumble dry at high temperatures. ⚠️ Washing or drying at excessive temperatures may cause the 3D print to loosen or peel from the fabric over time.

description: 优雅马蹄莲/花瓣美学戒指（3D 打印款）完整说明 一: 项目主要特点 自然植物美学： 戒指正面以盛开的马蹄莲（或优雅花瓣）为灵感核心，层叠交错的花瓣自然包裹，线条优美流畅，散发着清新、高雅且浪漫的自然气息。 精致的同心圆层纹理： 如图中展示的那样，纯白色的花瓣表面与戒圈上呈现出极其细腻、宛如天然年轮或水波纹般的等高线层纹，为简约的花卉造型增添了独特的现代工艺质感。 一体化流线戒圈： 戒圈由花茎与花托部分自然向下延伸过渡，整体结构浑然天成，无需任何后期拼接，一次性3D打印成型。 纯净的微缩雕塑感： 采用纯白色的视觉呈现，既像一件精美的艺术微雕，又兼具现代极简主义首饰的高级时尚感。 二: 适用场景 & 适配人群 适用场景 日常清新/法式穿搭配饰： 作为指尖的点睛之笔，完美适配法式优雅、森系清新或日常休闲的穿搭风格，低调中透着精致。 浪漫节日与纪念日礼物： 寓意纯洁与美好，非常适合作为情人节、生日或纪念日送给伴侣、闺蜜的浪漫小礼物。 桌面艺术陈列： 不佩戴时，将其摆放在梳妆台或首饰架上，其优美的花朵造型本身就是一件极具观赏价值的桌面小品。 适配人群 自然与花卉元素爱好者： 偏爱植物、花朵主题，钟情于温润柔和设计风格的首饰佩戴者。 极简美学饰品控： 喜欢线条流畅、造型不浮夸且带有独特3D打印肌理感的小众设计配饰达人。 3D 打印创客玩家： 喜欢打印精致微缩有机曲面、热衷于尝试不同纯色或丝绸质感耗材的DIY爱好者。 三: 3D 打印设置（0.4mm 标准喷嘴通用参数） 为了完美呈现马蹄莲花瓣边缘的轻薄感以及表面细腻的同心圆层纹，建议参考以下切片参数： 层高（Layer Height）： 推荐设置为 0.08mm - 0.12mm。较细的层高能让花瓣交叠处的弧度极其平滑，彻底消除阶梯感。 墙数量 / 外轮廓（Walls / Perimeters）： 3 - 4 层。多层外墙能有效保证戒圈及外翻花瓣的结构强度，防止日常佩戴时受力断裂。 填充率（Infill）： 推荐设置为 100%（实心打印）。实心填充能带来更好的手感重量，并确保花瓣与戒圈连接处的绝对牢固。 打印速度： 外部可见区域（Outer Wall）建议降速至 30-40 mm/s。慢速打印是保证花瓣边缘平整、表面纹理清晰均匀的关键。 四: 补充打印 & 组装建议 尺寸缩放与佩戴参考： 标准首饰佩戴款（按手指内径缩放）： 测量佩戴手指的直径后，在切片软件中等比例缩放模型内径，建议比实际手指直径大 0.3mm - 0.5mm，确保佩戴顺畅舒适。 桌面摆件收藏款（50-70mm）： 放大尺寸后可以作为精致的桌面花朵雕塑或小型戒指展示座。 耗材与色彩推荐： 纯白骨瓷风（如图中效果）： 使用 哑光白（Matte White）或象牙白 PLA 耗材，呈现出类似高级陶瓷或石膏雕塑的纯净质感。 浪漫彩金/珍珠风： 推荐使用丝绸白金（Silk White/Pearl）耗材，打印出的花瓣自带珍珠般的柔和光泽，极其惊艳。 佩戴舒适度优化： 打印完成后，建议用 800 目以上的细砂纸将戒指内圈稍微打磨光滑，确保贴合皮肤时温润舒适、不刮手。
