description: 三叶花瓣戒指（3D 打印款）完整说明 一: 项目主要特点 高雅自然的植物姿态： 戒指正面以三片舒展的鸢尾（或百合类）花瓣为设计核心，花瓣呈品字形向外绽放，微翘的边缘与凹陷的瓣心构筑出立体的有机曲面，极具优雅与浪漫氛围。 细腻指纹般的叶脉纹理： 如图中所示，花瓣内部与戒圈表面布满了顺着曲面起伏延伸的同心圆与等高线纹理，宛如天然植物的叶脉肌理，将现代 3D 打印的层纹之美展现得淋漓尽致。 极简流线一体化戒圈： 戒圈由下方自然向上分叉过渡为支撑花瓣的花茎，整体线条纤细优雅，一次性 3D 打印成型，结构轻巧且贴合手形。 魅惑高贵的紫色视觉： 采用了极具神秘感的哑光深紫色呈现，既带着轻奢复古的艺术气质，又能作为指尖最吸睛的色彩点缀。 二: 适用场景 & 适配人群 适用场景 日常精致/法式复古穿搭： 作为指尖的轻奢亮眼单品，完美适配法式优雅、小众设计师风、文艺优雅或早春浪漫系穿搭。 节日浪漫与闺蜜心意礼品： 鸢尾花象征着爱意、光明与优雅，非常适合作为生日、情人节或纪念日送给伴侣、闺蜜的暖心好礼。 桌面艺术微雕展示： 不佩戴时将其独立立于妆台或陈列盘中，优美的花朵造型宛如一座精致的极简植物雕塑。 适配人群 植物美学与花卉元素爱好者： 偏爱自然花草主题、钟情于线条柔美且富有灵动感配饰的时尚爱好者。 紫色与小众设计师饰品控： 偏爱高饱和度色彩、追求小众不易撞款且带有独特肌理质感的配饰收集者。 3D 打印精致模型玩家： 喜欢打印薄壁曲面、微缩有机雕塑以及热衷于尝试彩色/丝绸耗材的创客玩家。 三: 3D 打印设置（0.4mm 标准喷嘴通用参数） 为了确保三片花瓣悬空的边缘成型平整、花瓣内部叶脉纹理清晰锐利，建议参考以下切片参数： 层高（Layer Height）： 强烈建议设置为 0.08mm - 0.12mm。较细的层高能保证花瓣弯曲处的弧度平滑无台阶感，并完美还原微缩叶脉的细腻质感。 支撑设置（Support）： 建议开启 树状支撑（Tree Support） 。仅在倾斜延伸的花瓣下沿生成少许支撑，确保花瓣悬空部位打印不塌陷且易于拆除。 墙数量 / 外轮廓（Walls / Perimeters）： 3 - 4 层。充足的外墙厚度能确保纤细的花茎与薄花瓣在佩戴时具备足够的抗断裂强度。 填充率（Infill）： 推荐设置为 100%（实心打印）。实心填充能带来更好的结构刚性与更扎实的手感。 打印速度： 外部可见区域（Outer Wall）建议降速至 25-35 mm/s，确保薄花瓣边缘成型精致不拉丝。 四: 补充打印 & 组装建议 尺寸缩放与佩戴参考： 标准首饰佩戴款（按手指内径缩放）： 测量佩戴手指的直径后，在切片软件中等比例缩放模型内径，建议内径比实际手指直径大 0.3mm - 0.5mm，以确保佩戴体验顺畅舒适。 桌面小雕像（50-70mm）： 放大尺寸打印后可以作为桌面上极其吸睛的植物微雕摆件或戒指架。 耗材与色彩推荐： 魅惑深紫风（如图中效果）： 使用 哑光紫（Matte Purple）或薰衣草紫 PLA 耗材，呈现充满艺术画廊感的高级雕塑质感。 梦幻丝绸/珍珠风： 推荐使用 丝绸紫（Silk Purple）或珍珠白 耗材，光线照射在花瓣的波浪纹理上会产生迷人的光泽折射。 佩戴舒适度与安全优化： 花瓣尖端在打印成型后可能稍显利落，建议用细砂纸对尖端进行微小的圆角打磨，防止日常佩戴时勾挂衣物。 拆除支撑后，建议用 800 目以上的细砂纸将戒指内圈打磨光滑，使其贴合手指时更加温润亲肤。

description: 猫咪开口戒指（3D 打印款）完整说明 一、项目主要特点 猫咪轮廓首尾相呼应： 采用灵动的开口戒指结构，将猫咪坐立的背影剪影与卷曲的小尾巴巧妙地设置在开口两侧。佩戴时仿佛一只小猫温柔地环抱着你的手指，极具治愈感与趣味性。 极简几何剪影美学： 去掉了繁琐的面部与毛发纹理，仅保留小猫标志性的尖耳朵、圆润的身体弧度以及俏皮卷曲的尾巴尖。抽象的几何线条勾勒出高级的现代设计感，简约而不单调。 同心圆年轮纹理： 如图中所示，猫咪正面的微弧曲面完美契合了 3D 打印特有的“同心圆”等高线层纹。这些层纹如同树木年轮或指纹般自然延伸，为平整的金属感饰品增添了独特的艺术肌理。 贴合舒适的开口结构： 戒圈采用平滑加厚设计，内侧打磨平整，开口处预留了自然的过度空间，具有一定的微调延展性，大幅降低了圈号选错的风险。 二、适用场景 & 适配人群 适用场景 日常百搭萌系配饰： 时尚吸睛又不夸张，完美适配日系甜美风、极简通勤风以及日常休闲穿搭，是工位上极佳的治愈小单品。 猫奴/铲屎官专属标志： 作为爱猫人士的“身份认同”饰品，非常适合作为情侣款、闺蜜戒指或赠送给养猫朋友的趣味礼物。 桌面解压小软装： 取下摆放在键盘旁或办公桌上，其立体的猫咪背影本身就是一件极具温度的微缩极简雕塑。 适配人群 资深猫奴/宠物爱好者： 对猫咪元素毫无抵抗力，喜欢将萌宠元素融入生活细节的铲屎官们。 小众极简饰品收集者： 偏爱造型别致、线条流畅、具有几何现代感与艺术肌理首饰的潮流人士。 FDM 打印创客玩家： 喜欢挑战精致微缩小模型，享受随时随地根据手指尺寸“量体裁衣”定制打印的 DIY 达人。 三、3D 打印设置（0.4mm 标准喷嘴通用参数） 为了确保猫咪 ears（耳朵）与尾巴尖端的细节锐利，同时呈现出图中那种精致的同心圆表面肌理，建议参考以下切片设置： 层高（Layer Height）： 强烈建议使用 0.08mm - 0.12mm（较低的层高能让猫咪背部的同心圆纹理过渡得极其平滑，同时确保猫耳和尾巴尖不糊）。 墙数量 / 外轮廓（Walls / Perimeters）： 3 - 4 层（保证戒圈有足够的壁厚去承受微小的开口形变，避免佩戴时断裂）。 填充率（Infill）： 作为日常佩戴的戒指，建议设置为 100%（实心打印），这不仅能大幅提升戒圈强度，还能赋予其如同真正金属首饰般的沉甸分量感。 打印速度： 外部可见区域（Outer Wall）请务必降速至 25-35 mm/s，慢速打印是确保同心圆层纹清晰无瑕疵、猫耳尖端不拉丝的关键。 四、补充打印 & 组装建议 尺寸缩放与圈号参考： 标准首饰佩戴款（尺寸缩放参考常规戒指内径 18–22mm）： 测量佩戴手指的直径后，在切片软件中等比例缩放模型，使模型内圈直径（X/Y 轴内径）比实际手指直径大 0.3mm - 0.5mm。虽然是开口戒指，但预留少许公差能大幅提升佩戴舒适度。 桌面萌宠雕像（50–80mm）： 放大至手心大小，猫咪的背影和卷尾巴结构在放大后会呈现出极强的治愈系雕塑质感。 耗材与色彩推荐： 丝绸/蚕丝金属色（如图中效果）： 使用 蚕丝银（Silk Silver） 、 蚕丝白金 或 枪灰色 耗材，能打印出类似氧化哑光银首饰的高级金属光泽，极大提升质感。 哑光陶瓷色： 使用 哑光白（Matte White） 、 象牙黄 或 哑光黑 ，能消除塑料光泽，呈现出如白瓷或黑曜石般的抽象艺术感。 韧性强化提示： 虽然该戒指开口较宽，但如果需要微调圈号，建议使用 PLA+（高韧性 PLA） 或 PETG 耗材打印，这能防止在手动撑开或捏紧戒圈时发生脆性断裂。 边缘倒角与打磨： 打印完成后，建议用 1000 目以上的细砂纸将戒指内圈与开口处（特别是尾巴尖与猫耳朵边缘）轻轻打磨倒角，确保佩戴时不卡手、不刮皮肤。

description: 蔓藤羽叶植物戒指（3D 打印款）完整说明 一: 项目主要特点 优雅舒展的羽叶与藤蔓造型： 戒指正面以层次交叠的羽状叶片与弯曲缠绕的柔美藤蔓为核心设计，侧面戒圈融入了复古的蔓藤花纹浮雕，呈现出浓郁的新艺术运动（Art Nouveau）与古典自然美学风格。 精细微雕的叶脉与卷草纹理： 如图中所示，每片叶子上都刻画有极为细腻的平行叶脉纹路，藤蔓节点处带有精致的微型卷草与果实/花蕾造型，配合表面细密的 3D 打印层纹，触感丰富且极具雕塑感。 立体流线型戒圈过渡： 戒圈从后方的光滑平面平滑过渡至前方的多层交叠叶片，既保持了贴合手指的舒适感，又在指背形成立体的视觉焦点。 纯白石膏/骨瓷微缩美学： 采用哑光白/石膏白色质感呈现，赋予了作品宛如天然白瓷、石膏微雕或古典象牙雕刻般的雅致气息。 二: 适用场景 & 适配人群 适用场景 法式复古/精致日常穿搭： 作为指尖轻奢优雅的造型亮点，完美适配法式复古、文艺森系、小众设计师风或早春浪漫系穿搭，显得优雅而不失个性。 自然学与古典美学饰品： 蔓藤与叶片象征着生长、生生不息与自然之美，非常适合作为带有温馨寓意的个人幸运指环或纪念礼物。 桌面艺术微雕展示： 不佩戴时立于桌面上（如图中姿态），其独特的立体半包围姿态本身就是一件精美的植物微缩艺术雕塑。 适配人群 植物美学与新艺术风格爱好者： 偏爱自然花草主题、钟情于复古藤蔓线条与优雅立体造型的戒指佩戴者。 小众雕塑感饰品收集者： 偏爱白色系、追求高细节雕刻质感且不易撞款的潮流配饰达人。 3D 打印精致模型创客： 喜欢挑战打印悬空交叠叶片、微缩藤蔓细节以及热衷于尝试哑光白/陶瓷感耗材的 DIY 玩家。 三: 3D 打印设置（0.4mm 标准喷嘴通用参数） 为了确保多层交叠的叶片尖端成型锐利、叶脉与侧面蔓藤浮雕细节清晰不糊化，建议参考以下切片参数： 层高（Layer Height）： 强烈建议设置为 0.08mm - 0.10mm。较细的层高能保证微缩叶脉细节清晰锐利，且使叶片弯曲弧面过渡极其平滑。 支撑设置（Support）： 必须开启支撑！建议使用 树状支撑（Tree Support） ，仅在最前方悬空延伸的叶片下沿生成少量支撑，注意避开侧面蔓藤花纹，方便干净拆除。 墙数量 / 外轮廓（Walls / Perimeters）： 3 - 4 层。充足的外墙厚度能确保纤细的叶片边缘与藤蔓在佩戴受力时具备足够的抗断裂强度。 填充率（Infill）： 推荐设置为 100%（实心打印）。实心填充能带来更好的结构刚度与扎实的手感分量。 打印速度： 外部可见区域（Outer Wall）建议降速至 20-30 mm/s，确保复杂叶脉与卷草细节精准打印不拉丝。 四: 补充打印 & 组装建议 尺寸缩放与佩戴参考： 按手指内径等比例缩放： 测量佩戴手指的直径后，在切片软件中等比例缩放模型内径。建议内径比实际手指直径大 0.3mm - 0.5mm，以确保穿脱顺畅舒适，佩戴在食指或中指上视觉效果最佳。 桌面小雕像（50-70mm）： 放大尺寸打印后可以作为桌面上极其吸睛的植物微雕摆件或戒指托架。 耗材与色彩推荐： 纯白石膏/骨瓷风（如图中效果）： 使用 哑光白（Matte White）或大理石白 PLA 耗材，呈现现代艺术雕塑般的纯粹高级质感。 做旧古银/复古青铜风： 推荐使用 丝绸银 或 古铜色 耗材。打印完成后，用黑色丙烯颜料对叶脉和藤蔓缝隙进行“渍洗做旧”，能瞬间呈现出博物馆艺术品般的复古立体感！ 佩戴舒适度与安全优化： 叶片尖端在打印成型后可能稍显利落，建议用细砂纸对尖端进行微小的圆角打磨，防止日常佩戴时勾挂衣物。 拆除支撑后，用 800 目以上的细砂纸将戒指内圈与手指接触面打磨光滑，使其贴合皮肤时更加温润亲肤。

description: 盛开玫瑰戒指（3D 打印款）完整说明 一: 项目主要特点 立体盛开的精雕玫瑰： 戒指正面以一朵层层叠叠、自然包裹绽放的立体玫瑰花头为核心设计，花瓣边缘微卷且层次分明，呈现出极其逼真且高贵优雅的视觉焦点。 双侧浮雕叶脉与花茎戒圈： 戒圈两侧向上延伸出栩栩如生的玫瑰叶片与细小花茎浮雕，叶片上带有清晰呈羽状散开的叶脉纹理，使整枚戒指从正面到侧面都具备连贯的植物美学流动感。 经典一体化戒指结构： 戒圈由下方自然过渡至上方托起整朵盛开的玫瑰，结构完整牢固，兼具华丽的存在感与贴合手指的佩戴体验。 纯白骨瓷/石膏微缩美学： 采用哑光白/石膏白色质感呈现，赋予了作品宛如天然白瓷、石膏微雕或古典象牙雕刻般的雅致浪漫气息。 二: 适用场景 & 适配人群 适用场景 节日浪漫与告白赠礼： 玫瑰是爱情与浪漫的经典象征，非常适合作为情人节、求婚、生日或纪念日送给伴侣的仪式感满满的好礼。 法式复古/精致日常穿搭： 作为指尖夸张而优雅的亮眼单品，完美适配法式优雅、小众设计师风、浪漫婚礼或早春约会系穿搭。 桌面艺术微雕展示： 不佩戴时将其独立立于妆台或陈列盘中，优美的玫瑰花姿宛如一座精致的极简植物雕塑。 适配人群 玫瑰与花卉美学爱好者： 偏爱玫瑰花主题、钟情于复古优雅与立体花朵造型的戒指佩戴者。 小众浪漫首饰收集达人： 偏爱白色系、追求高细节雕刻质感且不易撞款的配饰达人。 3D 打印精致模型创客： 喜欢挑战打印多层重叠花瓣、微缩叶脉细节以及热衷于尝试哑光白/陶瓷感耗材的 DIY 玩家。 三: 3D 打印设置（0.4mm 标准喷嘴通用参数） 为了确保玫瑰花瓣层层递进不粘连、侧面叶脉与花茎浮雕细节清晰锐利，建议参考以下切片参数： 层高（Layer Height）： 强烈建议设置为 0.08mm - 0.10mm。较细的层高是确保多层立体花瓣边缘平滑、不出现明显阶梯纹的关键。 支撑设置（Support）： 必须开启支撑！建议使用 树状支撑（Tree Support） ，仅在最外层花瓣底部下沿生成少许支撑，注意避免支撑触及内部密集的花瓣缝隙，以便干净拆除。 墙数量 / 外轮廓（Walls / Perimeters）： 3 - 4 层。充足的外墙厚度能确保花瓣边缘与戒圈在佩戴受力时具备足够的抗断裂强度。 填充率（Infill）： 推荐设置为 100%（实心打印）。实心填充能带来更好的结构刚度与扎实的手感分量。 打印速度： 外部可见区域（Outer Wall）与顶层建议降速至 20-25 mm/s，慢速打印能保证密集花瓣与叶脉细节精准成型不拉丝。 四: 补充打印 & 组装建议 尺寸缩放与佩戴参考： 按手指内径等比例缩放： 测量佩戴手指的直径后，在切片软件中等比例缩放模型内径。由于花头体积较立体，建议内径比实际手指直径大 0.3mm - 0.5mm，以确保穿脱顺畅，佩戴在食指或中指上效果最佳。 桌面小雕像（50-70mm）： 放大尺寸打印后可以作为桌面上极其吸睛的植物微雕摆件或戒指托盘。 耗材与色彩推荐： 纯白骨瓷风（如图中效果）： 使用 哑光白（Matte White）或石膏白 PLA 耗材，呈现现代艺术雕塑般的纯粹干净质感。 梦幻玫瑰粉/复古红： 亦可使用 哑光粉 、 深红 或 丝绸红 耗材，完美还原真实玫瑰的娇艳风采。 古银/做旧风： 推荐使用 丝绸银 耗材打印，完成后用黑色丙烯颜料对花瓣缝隙和叶脉进行“渍洗做旧”，能展现出哥特复古的银饰质感。 佩戴舒适度与安全优化： 花瓣最外侧边缘在打印成型后可能稍显利落，建议用细砂纸对尖端进行微小的圆角打磨，防止日常佩戴时勾挂蕾丝或丝绸衣物。 拆除支撑后，用 800 目以上的细砂纸将戒指内圈与手指接触面打磨光滑，使其贴合皮肤时更加温润亲肤。

description: Turn your favorite design into a unique 3D T-shirt 👕🖨️ These thin and flexible 3D prints are designed to be heat-transferred directly onto fabric using a household iron. Instructions 🛠️👕 Download the model and open it in Bambu Studio 💻 Print the model using the recommended settings and carefully remove it from the build plate. ⚠️ Handle with care — the model is extremely thin (approximately 0.3 mm) and may tear or deform if bent too aggressively. Prepare your ironing area: Place the T-shirt on an ironing board or a flat heat-resistant surface. Set your iron to a very high temperature (almost maximum heat, without steam) 🔥 Allow the iron to fully preheat before starting. Position the printed model on the desired area of the T-shirt and cover it with baking/parchment paper 📄 Apply firm pressure with the preheated iron for 15–20 seconds. For larger designs, move the iron slowly and evenly to ensure the entire model receives sufficient heat. Care Instructions 🧼 Wash garments at temperatures not exceeding 50°C (122°F). Turn the T-shirt inside out before washing whenever possible. Avoid bleach and aggressive washing programs. Do not tumble dry at high temperatures. ⚠️ Washing or drying at excessive temperatures may cause the 3D print to loosen or peel from the fabric over time.

description: 猫妖鳞片面具（3D 打印款）完整说明 一: 项目主要特点 奇幻生物美学： 巧妙融合了猫科动物的灵动耳廓与东方龙/奇幻野兽的鳞片元素，整体呈现出一种神秘、野性且优雅的妖精面具造型，极具视觉张力。 层叠复杂的鳞片肌理： 面具表面由成百上千片细腻的仿生鱼鳞/龙鳞紧密交织而成，从眉心向两侧呈放射状铺开，层次分明，立体感极强。 锐利夸张的边缘剪影： 耳朵外缘与面具轮廓带有大量尖锐、带有朋克风格的刺状装饰，配合明艳的红色，散发出浓郁的暗黑奇幻与魔幻现实主义色彩。 流线贴合的面部弧度： 整体呈现自然的内凹弧面，完美契合人脸轮廓，眼部开孔宽敞，兼顾了造型的艺术感与实际佩戴的视野。 二: 适用场景 & 适配人群 适用场景 化装舞会与万圣节派对： 作为惊艳全场的独立面部饰品，完美融入哥特风、精灵风、赛博巫术或奇幻角色扮演（Cosplay）的装扮中。 主题摄影与潮玩陈列： 不仅能佩戴，其极具雕塑感的造型也非常适合作为摄影道具，或挂在墙面上作为独特的现代艺术墙饰。 个性化节日伴手礼： 送给喜欢奇幻文学、桌游跑团或动漫展爱好者的绝佳硬核礼物。 适配人群 Cosplay 与奇幻爱好者： 钟情于魔幻、精灵、龙族等神秘生物设定，热衷于打造独特个性造型的玩家。 暗黑美学与先锋时尚达人： 偏爱夸张、张扬、具有强烈视觉符号感配饰的潮流人士。 3D 打印造型发烧友： 喜欢高难度复杂曲面打印、享受大体积精细模型制作挑战的创客玩家。 三: 3D 打印设置（0.4mm 标准喷嘴通用参数） 为了完美还原成百上千片细密鳞片与边缘利刺的锐利度，建议参考以下极限精度切片参数（ 注：由于面具属于大面积贴脸薄壁结构，强烈建议适当调慢速度 ）： 层高（Layer Height）： 推荐设置为 0.12mm - 0.16mm。兼顾打印效率与鳞片表面的细腻层纹表现。 墙数量 / 外轮廓（Walls / Perimeters）： 3 - 4 层。多层外墙能彻底保证密集的鳞片结构与边缘尖刺坚固不易折断。 填充率（Infill）： 15% - 20%（推荐使用 网格 Grid 或 陀螺仪 Gyroid 填充），既能保持面具整体的轻量化（佩戴不压鼻梁），又能提供足够的结构强度。 打印速度： 外部可见区域（Outer Wall）必须严格降速至 30-40 mm/s。由于面具表面有大量向外延伸的鳞片和倒刺，慢速能有效防止冷却不足导致的拉丝和变形。 四: 补充打印 & 组装建议 尺寸缩放与佩戴参考： 真人佩戴款（150-180mm 宽度）： 打印前建议使用卡尺测量自己双颊之间的最大宽度，在切片软件中对 X/Y 轴进行等比例微调，确保眼孔位置与自己的瞳距相匹配。 微缩收藏/摆件款（80-100mm）： 缩小尺寸后可搭配支架摆在桌面上作为精致的工艺品。 耗材与色彩推荐： 烈焰妖精风（如图中效果）： 使用 亮红色（Red） 、 金属赤红 或 熔岩橙 PLA 耗材，能瞬间突显出野兽与妖精的张扬与热烈。 暗夜精灵风： 使用 哑光黑 、 深紫色 或 丝绸暗金 ，后期可以通过局部干扫银色或金色颜料，让鳞片的层次感瞬间爆发，呈现出类似中世纪魔器的高级质感。 佩戴固定小贴士： 面具两侧边缘通常预留有穿线孔或微小凹槽，建议使用黑色松紧带或皮革绳穿过两侧固定；若需要直接贴脸，也可以在面具内侧贴上一层薄海绵条或防滑硅胶垫，能大幅提升长时间佩戴的舒适度。

Bring your favorite football memes to life on your wardrobe! This unique DIY project features the iconic silhouette of Erling Haaland, 3D printed with an ultra-thin thickness of 0.4 mm . How It's Made (PLA+ Method): For this specific shirt, PLA+ was used. Since this filament is tougher to melt, it requires a specific technique combining high heat and immediate pressure: Setup: Lay the t-shirt perfectly flat on a smooth, heat-resistant surface (like floor tiles). Placement: Position the main Haaland design, then carefully place the 2 or 3 small detached pieces that aren't connected to the rest. Protection: Cover the entire design with tightly stretched baking paper. Heating: Use a heat gun to melt the filament onto the fabric through the baking paper. Pressing (The key step): Immediately after heating, firmly press a wooden cutting board directly onto the hot baking paper to force the melted filament into the fabric mesh for a solid bond. ⚠️ Warning: Do not stay in one spot for too long with the heat gun! Heat evenly and keep moving, then press immediately to avoid deforming the plastic. 💡 Pro Tip: Which filament should you use? Standard PLA with a household iron (Possible, but not recommended): You can technically try using regular PLA with a standard iron (no steam) and baking paper, but the result isn't great. The plastic doesn't bond well to the fabric and tends to peel off easily. TPU Filament (The absolute best option): For the best results, we highly recommend using TPU (flexible filament) instead. It works beautifully with a regular household iron (no steam) . When heated, the TPU melts right into the fabric mesh, blending with the textile. This gives you maximum flexibility, a softer feel, and incredible longevity. 🧼 Care Instructions: To ensure your design lasts as long as possible, always wash the t-shirt at a low temperature and inside out .

This project is a premium parametric Cotton Pad Dispenser (Porta Algodão Dispensador) with a vertical U-shaped front slot. It allows you to load a stack of circular cotton pads from the top and easily pull pads out one-by-one from the bottom. Fully parametric in OpenSCAD, it features three standard capacities, optional screw-on lid configuration, and deep aesthetic customization. --- UNLIMITED CUSTOMIZATION --- With over 30 texture patterns and adjustable scales, this project offers hundreds of unique combinations for you to create an exclusive dispenser. --- PARAMETER GUIDE --- 1. Size & Capacity - Size Selection: Choose between three height capacities: - Small (P): Height 80mm (Holds approx. 20 cotton pads) - Medium (M): Height 120mm (Holds approx. 35 cotton pads) - Large (G): Height 160mm (Holds approx. 50 cotton pads) - Has_Lid: Option to include a screw-on lid. - Enabled (Yes): Adds a top thread to the base and exports the lid. - Disabled (No): Removes threads entirely, leaving a clean open-top dispenser with a smooth, rounded upper rim. 2. Dispenser Slot Settings - Cutout Width: Controls the width of the vertical dispensing slot (Default: 35mm). It is optimized to be wide enough for your fingers to easily pull a pad out, but narrow enough to keep the pads stacked securely inside. - Bottom Lip: Height of the bottom retaining wall that supports the stack (Default: 8mm). 3. Aesthetics and Texture - Surface Pattern: Applies geometric textures in high/low relief to the outer face (Default: Grid Diagonal). - Pattern Depth: Controls how pronounced the texture is (recommended: 0.6mm). - Pattern Scale: Adjusts the size of the texture tiles. Small variations in this scale dramatically transform the visual effect, essentially creating entirely new textures from a single base pattern. You can fine-tune the look from bold geometric shapes to fine, intricate details. Scale effects on the same pattern - Text Bands: Show customized text at the top (Default: "COTTON"). - Logo Patch: Creates a smooth, centralized area on the base for logos or custom labeling. --- TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS & PRINTING --- - Support-Free Design: Both the dispenser base and the lid print completely without supports. The bottom of the U-slot is a semi-circle that prints cleanly in mid-air, and the inside has straight 62.0mm cylinder walls to prevent soft cotton pads from catching or tearing. - Smart Lidless Finishes: When printing without a lid, the top edge of the dispenser is automatically detailed with a smooth, 1.0mm double-rounded rim (both inner and outer lips). This ensures that cotton pads don't snag when loading and the top is completely safe and pleasant to touch. - Perfect Thread Synchronization: When the lid is enabled, the metric threading system includes a hardcoded thread phase (angular offset). This guarantees that when you fully tighten the lid, the texture patterns on the lid and the base align flawlessly, even with the vertical slot cutout. --- RECOMMENDED PRINT SETTINGS (Bambu Studio / OrcaSlicer) --- RECOMMENDED PRINT SETTINGS (Bambu Studio / OrcaSlicer) --- - Layer Height: 0.16mm (Optimal) - Wall Generator: Arachne (Required for sharp texture details) - Line Width: 0.6mm (Outer & Inner walls) - Infill: 10 Gyroid or Cross Hatch - Speed: 100 mm/s (Outer & Inner walls for premium finish) - Supports: No supports needed! Wear it alone to showcase quiet dominance, or stack alongside wing and marine-series rings to create striking contrast between tough and soft aesthetics. The world endlessly chases ceremonial coronation, yet many overlook the throne within. Shaped as a hollow gothic crown, Crown Veil reminds you not to crave validation from others. description: Turn your own SVG design into a thin, customizable 3D-printed graphic for a shirt or other fabric project. Upload a closed SVG file, choose the final width and thickness, and generate a print-ready model directly in MakerWorld Parametric Model Maker. The design is automatically centered and resized while preserving its original proportions. Horizontal mirroring is enabled by default for transfer workflows that require the design to be reversed. Disable it if your application method does not require mirroring. Features: Upload your own closed SVG design Adjustable final width from 20 to 250 mm Adjustable thickness from 0.2 to 1.0 mm Optional horizontal mirroring Automatic centering and proportional scaling Flat, support-free geometry How to use: Upload a clean, closed SVG file. Set the desired final width. Select the design thickness. Keep mirroring enabled if required by your transfer method. Generate the model and inspect it carefully in your slicer. Test the material and transfer process on scrap fabric first. Known limitations: Separate SVG islands will print as separate pieces. Open paths, overlapping paths and excessive SVG canvas whitespace may produce unexpected results. Heat-transfer temperature, adhesion and wash durability depend on the filament, fabric and application method. No assembly required. Step-by-Step Guide: Step 1: Lay your clothing flat on a hard, sturdy table . (Do NOT use a soft ironing board). Step 2: Place your printed PLA name on the fabric exactly where you want it. Step 3: 🛑 CRITICAL WARNING: Cover the PLA text completely with a sheet of baking paper! NEVER let the hot metal of the iron directly touch the PLA , or you will ruin your iron! Step 4: Set your iron to Medium-High heat (Cotton/Linen setting, around 150-160°C). Turn OFF the steam function. Step 5: Press the iron down firmly over the baking paper for 10 to 15 seconds . (Do NOT rub or slide the iron, just press straight down with strong pressure). Step 6: Remove the iron. DO NOT PEEL THE PAPER YET! Wait about 1 minute for the clothing and PLA to completely cool down and harden. Once cool to the touch, gently peel away the baking paper. (💡 Pro Tip: If any edges aren't fully stuck down, place the baking paper back over it and press firmly for another 5 seconds.) 🧼 Washing Tips: It is machine washable! Turn the garment inside out and wash with COLD water only . NEVER use hot water or a heated tumble dryer, or the PLA will melt and warp!

description: 极简灵狐手镯（3D 打印款）完整说明 一、项目主要特点 首尾呼应的环绕美学： 采用经典的 C 型开口手镯形态，巧妙地将狐狸的头部与蓬松的尾巴分别置于手镯的两端。佩戴时宛如一只灵动的白狐优雅地缠绕在腕间，极具动态美感与自然生机。 极简抽象雕塑质感： 摒弃了繁琐的毛发细节，提取狐狸最迷人的几何轮廓。硬朗的尖耳、修长的吻部与圆润流畅的尾巴形成鲜明对比，整体呈现出类似现代白瓷或骨雕的极简高级感。 灵动的微弹开口设计： 借助 3D 打印材料的物理特性与 C 型结构，手镯天然具备一定的韧性与微弹空间，既保证了佩戴的便捷性，又能很好地贴合不同粗细的手腕。 独特的层纹光影： 表面细腻均匀的 3D 打印层纹非但没有成为瑕疵，反而顺着手镯的弧度生长，形成了一种类似原生木纹或精细手工拉丝的特殊肌理，在侧光下极具艺术气息。 二、适用场景 & 适配人群 适用场景 极简/森系穿搭配饰： 作为日常出街的点睛之笔，完美适配极简风（Normcore）、森系复古风或新中式禅意穿搭，低调却极其吸睛。 精致的桌面首饰陈列： 不佩戴时，可将其挂在首饰架上，或直接立于桌面，本身就是一件极具欣赏价值的微缩动物雕塑。 独特的心意伴手礼： 狐狸常被赋予“灵智”与“守护”的寓意，作为礼物送给闺蜜或伴侣，既别致又充满浪漫色彩。 适配人群 小众设计首饰控： 厌倦了市面上千篇一律的金属手镯，追求有温度、有故事感、极简设计语言的饰品爱好者。 自然与动物爱好者： 对狐狸等灵性动物元素情有独钟的文艺青年。 3D 打印实用派： 喜欢将 3D 打印技术应用于日常生活穿搭，享受“所想即所得、随时定制尺寸”乐趣的创客玩家。 三、3D 打印设置（0.4mm 标准喷嘴通用参数） 为了确保手镯具备足够的结构强度（防止佩戴时断裂），同时完美展现狐狸五官的锐利感，建议参考以下切片参数： 层高（Layer Height）： 推荐使用 0.12mm - 0.16mm。较低的层高能够让狐狸尾巴的圆弧过渡更加顺滑，同时确保狐狸鼻尖和眼睛部位的细节不丢失。 墙数量 / 外轮廓（Walls / Perimeters）： 强烈建议设置为 4 - 5 层。对于手镯类受力模型，增加外墙厚度是提升整体抗折断韧性的最有效方法。 填充率（Infill）： 必须设置为 100%（实心打印）。开口手镯在穿脱时会产生向外撑开的应力，实心打印能赋予其最大的结构刚性与安全性。 打印速度： 外部可见区域（Outer Wall）建议降速至 30-40 mm/s，慢速打印能让狐狸头部的悬空面（如下巴处）成型更加完美，减少打磨工作量。 四、补充打印 & 组装建议 尺寸缩放与测量参考： 定制缩放： 打印前，请务必使用软尺或游标卡尺测量佩戴者手腕侧面（最窄处）的宽度。在切片软件中等比例缩放模型，使手镯开口的距离略小于手腕最窄宽度，手镯内径的宽度略大于手腕正面宽度即可。 耗材推荐（核心关键）： 材质选择： 由于手镯需要被微微撑开才能佩戴， 极其不建议使用普通脆性 PLA （很容易在戴上的瞬间“啪”地断裂）。强烈建议使用 PETG 、 ABS 或 PLA+（高韧性 PLA） 耗材，它们具有绝佳的弹性恢复力，能承受日常的穿脱形变。 色彩美学： 推荐 哑光白（Matte White） 、象牙白（Ivory） 展现骨雕质感；或者使用 仿木耗材（Wood PLA）打印后轻轻打磨，呈现出极其逼真的手工木雕手镯效果。 佩戴小贴士： 正确的佩戴方式是将手腕侧过来（手腕最窄的方向），将手镯开口对准手腕侧面滑入，然后再旋转至手腕正面，这样可以最大限度减少对手镯的强行拉扯。 边缘打磨： 打印完成后，建议使用 800 目 - 1000 目的细砂纸，将手镯内圈与皮肤接触的边缘进行轻轻打磨倒角，确保佩戴时极致亲肤、不刮手。

description: Give your lost item a way back home FoundIt Halo is a customizable lost-and-found tag designed for backpacks, suitcases and bags. Its simple, universal shape makes it suitable for everyday use, while the QR code connects the finder with the owner through the free FoundIt service. Unlike a traditional tag with a phone number or home address printed on it, FoundIt does not expose the owner’s personal details to everyone nearby. It provides a private way to recover lost belongings without publicly displaying the owner’s or finder’s contact information. How FoundIt works Each tag uses its own individual QR code generated on foundit.cc . When someone finds your item, they can scan the QR code and open a contact form connected to your tag. The finder can: send a message to the owner, attach a photo of the found item, share the exact location where the item is located, optionally provide an email address to enable two-way communication. If the finder confirms their email address, both sides can continue the conversation through FoundIt without revealing their email addresses to each other. The finder does not need to create an account or install an app. Create your own tag FoundIt is completely free and allows each account to create up to 20 tags for personal 3D printing. Before printing: Create a free account at foundit.cc/register . Generate a free tag code. Enter the code in the MakerLab Customizer. Check that the generated QR code opens the correct tag page. Generate and print the model. The visible tag number and the QR code must always use the same FoundIt code. Customization options The model can be adjusted directly in the customizer. You can change: the overall tag size, the position of the text, the attachment-hole style, the edge-rounding style, the printing configuration for the detailed face. The simple shape was designed to remain practical and versatile without limiting the tag to one specific type of item. Example file The included example model uses the tag number: PRM-N2E This is an active public demonstration tag connected to FoundIt. You are welcome to scan it and send a test message to see how the service works. For your own printed tag, replace PRM-N2E with a code generated in your FoundIt account. Recommended print settings Material: PETG Nozzle: 0.4 mm Layer height: 0.2 mm Infill: 60% The model was printed and tested on a Bambu Lab P2S. The printed QR code scanned correctly without any problems. Good contrast between the QR code and the base is strongly recommended. Black and white usually provide the most reliable result. Important note FoundIt is not a GPS tracker and does not actively track the location of your item. It cannot prevent theft or guarantee that a lost item will be returned. It provides a simple and private way for an honest finder to contact the owner after finding the tagged item.

description: 暗夜影尊 | Shadow Lord of Night 暗夜影尊戒指以极简立体黑豹头部为设计主体，摒弃繁杂纹路，以干净流畅的曲面塑造黑豹冷冽神秘的轮廓，眼窝、肌肉线条柔和却自带压迫感，完美诠释暗夜猎手低调隐忍又一击制胜的独特气质。黑豹象征隐秘力量、冷静智慧与独行自由，区别于猛虎外放的锋芒，它代表内敛深沉的强者，不张扬却拥有掌控全局的底气。指环一体浇筑成型，曲面戒圈贴合手部曲线，厚重却不笨重，长时间佩戴无负重感。素白坯体可做亮面抛光、磨砂哑光、复古做旧等多种工艺处理，适配高街潮搭、极简轻奢、暗黑禁欲、街头机车等各类穿搭，男女佩戴皆可烘托冷感高级气场。它是独行者的精神徽章，适合偏爱低调质感、不喜浮夸装饰的人群，寓意藏锋芒于心底，待时机到来便从容破局，时刻提醒佩戴者保持冷静自持，以沉稳姿态从容应对世间所有挑战。 Shadow Lord of Night Ring features a minimalist 3D panther head as its core design. Discarding complicated textures, smooth curved surfaces shape the panther’s cold, mysterious silhouette. The delicate contours of eye sockets and muscle lines carry subtle imposing aura, fully interpreting the unique temperament of the nocturnal hunter: quiet restraint paired with decisive power. The black panther symbolizes hidden strength, calm wisdom and solitary freedom. Unlike the tiger’s overt ferocity, it represents reserved, profound elites who hold overall control without drawing attention. The ring is integrally molded, with curved band fitting the natural shape of fingers. It delivers substantial visual weight without bringing heavy burden during all-day wear. The blank white blank supports polishing, matte finishing and vintage distressing, matching high-street fashion, minimalist luxury, dark ascetic and biker styles. It creates cool premium vibe for all genders. Serving as a spiritual emblem for loners, this ring suits people who prefer understated texture over flashy ornaments. It symbolizes hiding sharpness deep inside and seizing opportunities to break through calmly, reminding the wearer to stay composed and tackle all life challenges with steady poise.

description: It’s very easy to apply. Just follow these steps: Print: Use the template I’ve already prepared. I’ve set the thickness to 0.40 mm as this is the ideal thickness: it’s sturdy but still flexible. Position: Place the piece flat on your T-shirt (I recommend using one made from 100% cotton or a cotton blend). Protect: Cover the entire design with waxed paper (baking paper). Iron: Set the iron to a high temperature without steam. Apply firm pressure to the transfer for about 10 to 15 seconds. Check: Leave it to cool for a moment and make sure the edges are firmly adhered. If any part hasn’t stuck, carefully go over it again with the iron. Extra tip: To ensure it’s properly fixed, turn the T-shirt inside out and iron the inside (always protecting the printed area with the paper). To make it last longer (washing and care): Washing: Wash at a maximum temperature of 30 °C to prevent the print from fading over time. Tumble dryer: Avoid this at all costs: the extra heat will cause the plastic to peel away from the fabric. Materials: The file is printed in PLA and prints perfectly, but if you want it to be very flexible, with a rubbery texture and high performance, use TPU. About this design: The profile is optimised to adhere well without leaving a thick layer. The surface is very smooth because I’ve enabled the ‘smoothing’ function. It prints in a couple of minutes and uses very little filament. .3mf specifications: Layer height: 0.20 mm Total thickness: 0.40 mm Print bed: Tested on textured PEI If you print this, it would be a huge help if you could upload photos of yourself wearing it so I can see how it turned out and continue creating more designs. description: 沧眠 Sea Slumber｜儒艮海牛自然雕塑指环 以深海温柔生灵为灵感，沧眠海牛指环，将海洋静谧治愈力量凝固为纯白 3D 打印雕塑首饰，在硬朗神话、野性狩猎系列之外，开辟独属于温和自然主义的配饰篇章，献给偏爱松弛、治愈、原生自然美学的佩戴者。 整件作品一体成型哑光白材质，完整留存细腻打印肌理，摒弃多余雕花与贵金属点缀，以纯粹雕塑造型传递温柔内核。戒面完整立体雕刻海牛躯体，圆润敦厚的面部线条柔和舒缓，短鳍舒展搭于戒圈两侧，身躯顺着环身自然向下延伸；戒圈下半部分层层堆叠海藻浮雕，叶片脉络清晰立体，与海牛融为一体，复刻海牛穿梭海草床休憩的原生画面。整体线条全部柔和无锐角，宽厚敦实的生物造型自带安稳治愈感，大面积镂空海藻结构弱化厚重感，佩戴轻盈无负担。 “沧眠” 取沧海安眠之意，沧是包容万物的海洋，眠是海牛悠然休憩的松弛姿态。海牛是海洋中最温和的生灵，与世无争、缓慢自在，象征不内卷、不焦虑的人生态度：不必追赶世俗节奏，安然接纳自我节奏，在喧嚣世界守住内心平和。缠绕戒圈的海藻寓意生生不息的自然生机，代表温柔亦是强大力量，柔软内心同样能抵御外界浮躁。 不同于市面上张扬、锐利的重工配饰，沧眠主打低攻击性温柔雕塑感，无性别适配，男女佩戴皆能凸显松弛清冷气质。适配森系文艺穿搭、极简通勤、户外潜水爱好者造型、复古自然风穿搭；日常通勤低调柔和，艺术展、海边出行佩戴完美呼应自然主题，单戴干净治愈，搭配章鱼、美杜莎等同系列指环，刚柔碰撞打造层次丰富的雕塑配饰组合。 一体 3D 打印工艺保证整体流畅度，海藻镂空设计兼顾透气与美感，每一处生物肌理精细打磨，还原真实海洋生物质感。它不追求夺人眼球的夸张视觉，而是以内敛温柔的自然叙事打动佩戴者，是藏在指尖的一片海底海草床，一枚随身安放内心平静的治愈雕塑。 尘世喧嚣，人人皆可拥有一片深海安眠之地。沧眠以温顺海牛为形，以海藻为衬，戴上它，时刻保有一份从容松弛，在方寸指环之间，安放独属于你的深海温柔梦境。 Sea Slumber – Manatee Nature Sculpture Ring Inspired by the gentle creatures of the deep, Sea Slumber condenses the calming quiet power of the ocean into a matte white 3D printed sculptural ring. Beyond bold mythic and wild hunting-themed jewelry, it opens a unique chapter of soft naturalism for wearers drawn to relaxed, healing, organic aesthetics. Monolithically printed in uniform matte white, the piece retains delicate raw printing grain, rejecting excess carvings and precious metal decoration to convey its gentle core purely through sculptural form. The ring face features a full three-dimensional manatee: its rounded, placid facial contours calm and soothing, short flippers resting gently on either side of the band, its body curving naturally down the ring shank. The lower band is layered with stacked carved seaweed, each leaf vein sharply defined, seamlessly merging with the manatee to recreate the serene sight of it resting amid seagrass beds. Every line is soft and rounded without sharp edges; the thick, gentle creature silhouette delivers a sense of stable comfort, while large hollow seaweed cutouts lighten the design for weightless wear. The name Sea Slumber draws its meaning from the ocean’s quiet rest: “Sea” stands for the all-embracing waters, and “Slumber” evokes the unhurried, relaxed posture of resting manatees. Manatees are the gentlest ocean dwellers, peaceful and uncompetitive, symbolizing an anxiety-free way of life: no need to rush to match society’s pace, simply embrace your own rhythm and hold inner peace amid chaos. The seaweed wrapped around the band embodies endless natural vitality, a reminder that gentleness holds immense quiet strength, and a soft heart can still withstand worldly restlessness. Unlike loud, aggressive heavy sculptural jewelry on the market, Sea Slumber leans into low-key, calming sculptural charm with universal unisex appeal, highlighting a cool, relaxed aura on every wearer. It pairs flawlessly with forest literary fits, minimalist office wear, diving enthusiast outfits and vintage nature styling. Understated and mild for daily work, it harmonizes perfectly with natural themes at art exhibitions or coastal trips. Worn alone, it radiates quiet healing; stacked alongside the collection’s octopus and Medusa rings, it creates striking contrast between soft and bold sculptural layers. Seamless 3D printing ensures uninterrupted fluid lines, while hollow seaweed cutouts balance breathability and artistic detail. Every organic texture is finely refined to replicate authentic marine life. It does not seek dramatic attention; instead, it connects with the wearer through understated natural storytelling, a tiny seagrass bed carried on your fingertip, a portable sculpture to anchor your inner calm. Amid noisy worldly chaos, everyone deserves a quiet resting place beneath the waves. Shaped by a docile manatee and framed by flowing seaweed, Sea Slumber reminds you to move through life with unrushed ease. Within this tiny ring, hold your own gentle, peaceful ocean dream.

description: Turn your favorite design into a unique 3D T-shirt 👕🖨️ These thin and flexible 3D prints are designed to be heat-transferred directly onto fabric using a household iron. The result is a durable and eye-catching 3D design that combines modern 3D printing technology with fashion. Instructions 🛠️👕 Download the model and open it in Bambu Studio 💻 Print the model using the recommended settings and carefully remove it from the build plate. ⚠️ Handle with care — the model is extremely thin (approximately 0.3 mm) and may tear or deform if bent too aggressively. Prepare your ironing area: Place the T-shirt on an ironing board or a flat heat-resistant surface. Set your iron to a very high temperature (almost maximum heat, without steam) 🔥 Allow the iron to fully preheat before starting. Position the printed model on the desired area of the T-shirt and cover it with baking/parchment paper 📄 Apply firm pressure with the preheated iron for 15–20 seconds. For larger designs, move the iron slowly and evenly to ensure the entire model receives sufficient heat. Maintain consistent pressure throughout the process. ⏱️ Allow the area to cool for a few seconds, then carefully remove the paper. ✅ The model should remain attached to the fabric while the paper lifts away easily. (Optional) Turn the T-shirt inside out and iron the reverse side of the applied design for an additional 5–10 seconds to improve adhesion. 👕✨ Important ⚠️ Always use the iron at a very high temperature (near maximum setting) and with the steam function turned off. Insufficient heat or pressure may result in poor adhesion to the fabric. Test on a small area first if using delicate or heat-sensitive fabrics. Care Instructions 🧼 Wash garments at temperatures not exceeding 50°C (122°F). Turn the T-shirt inside out before washing whenever possible. Avoid bleach and aggressive washing programs. Do not tumble dry at high temperatures. ⚠️ Washing or drying at excessive temperatures may cause the 3D print to loosen or peel from the fabric over time.

description: Smart NFC Medical ID Keychain / Emergency Tag This is a functional, dual-sided medical alert keychain designed to store critical health information using an embedded NFC chip. It features the universally recognized Star of Life on one side and a Tap Here / Scan prompt on the other, making it immediately clear to paramedics, doctors, or bystanders that vital medical data is inside. Perfect for individuals with chronic conditions (such as diabetes, epilepsy, severe allergies, or heart conditions) and seniors. 🛠️ Print & Assembly Instructions: NFC Chip Embedded In-Print: This model features an internal pocket designed for a coin-style NFC sticker/disc (Optimized for NTAG216, 25mm diameter) . The Pause Trick: To insert the chip, insert a Pause command (Color Change or Pause at height) in your slicer right before the printer covers the internal pocket (around 0.6mm - 0.8mm above the pocket floor). Pop the NFC tag in, and resume printing. Dual-Color Setup: Print the base in one color (e.g., White) and change the filament to a contrasting color (e.g., Red or Black) for the text and icons to ensure high readability. Slicer Tip: If the fine details of the Rod of Asclepius (the snake) or hand icon don't appear in your slicer preview, enable the Arachne wall generator or Detect Thin Walls . 📱 How to Program: Use any free app like NFC Tools to write your data. With an NTAG216 chip, you have plenty of memory (888 bytes) to write text records with your Name, Emergency Contacts (ICE), Diagnoses, and Blood Type. Don't forget to Lock the tag after writing so nobody can erase your data!

description: 天使双翼羽毛戒指（3D 打印款）完整说明 一: 项目主要特点 双翼环抱的开放式戒圈： 戒指采用了错落环抱的开放式（Open-ring）设计，两翼羽毛向上立起延伸，呈现出轻盈羽化、仿佛随时准备高飞的动感姿态。 微雕羽毛肌理与滚珠勾边： 如图中所示，每片羽毛内部均雕刻有极其细腻纤细的羽轴与羽片纹路，翅膀的主骨骼边缘则镶嵌了一整排精致规整的微缩滚珠（Milgrain）浮雕，细节层次极其丰富。 优雅舒展的流线线条： 戒圈下方弧度平滑流畅，向两侧自然弯曲向上升腾为双翼，结构轻盈优雅，指背视觉拉长效果显著。 哑光银致/冷艳金属美学： 采用了高级感十足的哑光喷砂银（Matte Silver）质感呈现，既带着轻奢复古的艺术气质，又能展现出冷艳先锋的奇幻风格。 二: 适用场景 & 适配人群 适用场景 个性先锋/哥特轻奢穿搭： 作为指尖吸睛度极高的夸张造型戒指（Statement Ring），非常适合朋克风、暗黑哥特风、中性冷淡风或小众设计师服装的搭配。 守护与自由象征之礼： 羽翼象征着守护、自由、梦想与庇佑，非常适合作为生日、毕业季或特别纪念日送给 伴侣、闺蜜或自己的暖心寓意好礼。 桌面微缩雕塑展示： 不佩戴时将其独立立于陈列盘中，对称向上舒展的双翼宛如一件精美的微型金属雕塑艺术品。 适配人群 羽毛/翅膀元素与奇幻风爱好者： 偏爱天使羽翼、神话图腾以及富有流动感与线条美配饰的时尚爱好者。 微雕细节控与银饰玩家： 钟情于极细纹理、滚珠边框工艺以及追求哑光银/冷金属质感的小众首饰收集者。 3D 打印精致模型创客： 喜欢打印高难度薄片立立体结构、细微密集纹理以及热衷于尝试丝绸/喷砂耗材的 DIY 玩家。 三: 3D 打印设置（0.4mm 标准喷嘴通用参数） 为了确保向上延伸的羽毛薄片成型平整、羽轴纹路与边缘滚珠颗粒清晰锐利，建议参考以下切片参数： 层高（Layer Height）： 强烈建议设置为 0.08mm - 0.10mm。极细的层高能保证微缩滚珠颗粒不糊化、羽毛斜面过渡平滑无台阶感。 支撑设置（Support）： 必须开启支撑！建议使用 树状支撑（Tree Support） ，仅在两侧翅膀悬空向上延伸的下沿生成少许支撑，切勿让支撑接触羽毛正面纹理，以便干净剥离。 墙数量 / 外轮廓（Walls / Perimeters）： 4 层。较厚的外墙能确保纤细的羽毛薄片与开放式戒圈交界处在佩戴受力时具备足够的韧性与抗断裂强度。 填充率（Infill）： 推荐设置为 100%（实心打印）。实心填充能带来更好的结构刚度与更扎实的手感。 打印速度： 外部可见区域（Outer Wall）建议降速至 20-25 mm/s，慢速打印能保证密集滚珠与细小羽纹精准成型不拉丝。 四: 补充打印 & 组装建议 尺寸缩放与佩戴参考： 按手指内径缩放： 测量佩戴手指的直径后，在切片软件中等比例缩放模型内径。开放式戒圈在打印成型后硬质耗材通常较难手动弯折，建议内径比实际手指直径大 0.3mm - 0.5mm，佩戴在食指或中指上视觉效果最佳。 桌面小雕像（50-70mm）： 放大尺寸打印后可以作为桌面上极其吸睛的羽翼微雕摆件。 耗材与色彩推荐： 哑光银/喷砂银风（如图中效果）： 使用 丝绸银（Silk Silver）或哑光银灰 PLA/PETG 耗材，呈现高级感十足的哑光金属雕塑质感。 古典做旧银风： 使用丝绸银耗材打印后，可用黑色丙烯颜料对羽毛缝隙和滚珠间隙进行“渍洗做旧”，再用干刷法蘸取少许银色颜料刷在凸起处，能瞬间呈现出博物馆级别的做旧银饰效果。 佩戴舒适度与安全优化： 羽毛顶部尖端与边缘羽齿在打印成型后可能稍显利落，建议用细砂纸对尖端进行微小的圆角打磨，防止日常佩戴时勾挂衣物或划伤皮肤。 拆除支撑后，用 800 目以上的细砂纸将戒指内圈与手指接触面打磨光滑，使其贴合皮肤时更加温润亲肤。

description: 赤络环Crimson Vine Ring 这枚赤络环，以自然原生的藤蔓根系为核心设计灵感，挣脱传统首饰规整刻板的形制束缚，将山野之间盘根交错的藤蔓形态完整复刻于戒身之上。通体甄选温润的朱砂红材质一体雕琢，没有多余纹饰，依靠镂空缠绕的枝蔓结构构建戒圈肌理，粗细错落的枝节相互交织缠绕，孔洞疏密有致，既有坚硬立体的结构支撑，又保留了植物藤蔓柔软蜿蜒的自然气韵。 匠人级的立体雕刻工艺赋予戒指细腻的手感，每一处枝节的凸起、转折、弧度都经过反复打磨，边缘圆润不硌肤，日常佩戴贴合指腹。浓郁复古的正红色调沉稳高级，不艳俗、不张扬，哑光质感弱化了色彩的尖锐感，让戒指兼具复古暗黑美学与东方含蓄的审美意境。镂空设计不仅减轻了戒身自重，长时间佩戴无压迫感，光影透过镂空缝隙落在肌肤上，形成细碎灵动的光影层次，抬手之间自带氛围感。 在风格适配层面，这枚戒指拥有极强的百搭属性。日常搭配简约通勤穿搭，可为素色穿搭增添设计亮点；搭配朋克、复古、森系、新中式穿搭时，更是点睛配饰。它褪去了珠宝首饰浮华的装饰属性，转而承载坚韧、羁绊、共生的精神寓意，缠绕的藤蔓象征人与人之间紧密联结的羁绊，也代表自我向内扎根、向阳生长的人生态度。无论是作为日常佩戴的私藏配饰，还是小众独特的礼物赠予挚友、爱人，赤络环都区别于市面上千篇一律的素圈戒指。没有浮夸的钻石镶嵌，依靠纯粹的造型美学打动人心，3D建模一体成型的工艺保障了每一枚戒指纹路高度还原，细节精致耐品，长久佩戴不易变形褪色。在追求小众个性化配饰的当下，这枚藤蔓戒指跳出大众审美框架，用自然野性的设计诠释独立审美，佩戴者借由这枚戒指表达不随波逐流的生活态度，方寸戒身之间，藏着自然的力量与独属于佩戴者的温柔气场。 The Crimson Vine Ring draws its core design inspiration from native wild vines in nature, breaking away from the rigid, conventional shapes of traditional jewelry. description: Turn your favorite design into a unique 3D T-shirt 👕🖨️ These thin and flexible 3D prints are designed to be heat-transferred directly onto fabric using a household iron. The result is a durable and eye-catching 3D design that combines modern 3D printing technology with fashion. Instructions 🛠️👕 Download the model and open it in Bambu Studio 💻 Print the model using the recommended settings and carefully remove it from the build plate. ⚠️ Handle with care — the model is extremely thin (approximately 0.3 mm) and may tear or deform if bent too aggressively. Prepare your ironing area: Place the T-shirt on an ironing board or a flat heat-resistant surface. Set your iron to a very high temperature (almost maximum heat, without steam) 🔥 Allow the iron to fully preheat before starting. Position the printed model on the desired area of the T-shirt and cover it with baking/parchment paper 📄 Apply firm pressure with the preheated iron for 15–20 seconds. For larger designs, move the iron slowly and evenly to ensure the entire model receives sufficient heat. Maintain consistent pressure throughout the process. ⏱️ Allow the area to cool for a few seconds, then carefully remove the paper. ✅ The model should remain attached to the fabric while the paper lifts away easily. (Optional) Turn the T-shirt inside out and iron the reverse side of the applied design for an additional 5–10 seconds to improve adhesion. 👕✨ Important ⚠️ Always use the iron at a very high temperature (near maximum setting) and with the steam function turned off. Insufficient heat or pressure may result in poor adhesion to the fabric. Test on a small area first if using delicate or heat-sensitive fabrics. Care Instructions 🧼 Wash garments at temperatures not exceeding 50°C (122°F). Turn the T-shirt inside out before washing whenever possible. Avoid bleach and aggressive washing programs. description: Turn your favorite design into a unique 3D T-shirt 👕🖨️ These thin and flexible 3D prints are designed to be heat-transferred directly onto fabric using a household iron. The result is a durable and eye-catching 3D design that combines modern 3D printing technology with fashion. Instructions 🛠️👕 Download the model and open it in Bambu Studio 💻 Print the model using the recommended settings and carefully remove it from the build plate. ⚠️ Handle with care — the model is extremely thin (approximately 0.3 mm) and may tear or deform if bent too aggressively. Prepare your ironing area: Place the T-shirt on an ironing board or a flat heat-resistant surface. Set your iron to a very high temperature (almost maximum heat, without steam) 🔥 Allow the iron to fully preheat before starting. For larger designs, move the iron slowly and evenly to ensure the entire model receives sufficient heat. (Optional) Turn the T-shirt inside out and iron the reverse side of the applied design for an additional 5–10 seconds to improve adhesion. 👕✨ Important ⚠️ Always use the iron at a very high temperature (near maximum setting) and with the steam function turned off. Features Designed specifically for the BC-6 carrier Cools cans on both sides Refillable and reusable Large contact area against the cans Removable plug for easy filling Can be stored ready to use in the freezer Designed for straightforward 3D printing and assembly How to Fill It Carefully remove the filling plug using the correct Allen key (8mm). Make sure the inside is clean. Fill the cooler approximately 80–85% with ordinary water . Leave at least 15% empty space because water expands when it freezes. Reinstall the plug and tighten it gently. Do not overtighten it, as this may damage the threads or printed part. Wipe the cooler dry and check it carefully for leaks. For the first leak test, place it on a paper towel before freezing. Do not fill it completely. A fully filled container may crack or split when the water freezes. How to Use It Freeze the cooler for at least 8–12 hours , preferably overnight. Place the frozen cooler in the centre of the BC-6 carrier. Place three cans on each side of the cooler. After use, wipe it clean and return it to the freezer. For the best cooling performance, both the cans and the cooler should already be cold before being placed in the carrier. Important Information Ordinary water is recommended. Avoid unnecessary additives. Check regularly for cracks, damage or leaks. Do not use the cooler if it is damaged. The contents are not intended for drinking. Wash by hand using lukewarm water. Do not place it in a dishwasher or microwave, and avoid hot water. A watertight print and a properly sealed filling plug are required. PETG is generally more suitable than PLA for repeated freezer use.

description: LoopLoom - a fully 3D printable tablet weaving loom. The goal: Long warps. Small footprint. No tools. There's no question about it: A nice wooden loom is fun to use and looks great. But it also takes up quite a bit of space, isn't exactly light, and isn't cheap either. For beginners or when you're on the go: A printable loom would be just the thing! The facts: 2,5 meter (100 inch) warp. Adjustable waving angle. Printable on 256mm bed size. The three adjustable extensions allow you to stretch up to 2.5 meters of ribbon—realistically, you can weave braids about 2 meters long. Using the two front extensions, you can adjust the angle to be steeper or flatter: You can adjust the thread tension on all three extensions. On the left side of each extension, there is a screw that you can use to loosen or tighten it. To secure the thread at the beginning, simply tie a knot in the cord and pull it through the slot from the right: If you're used to doing it this way with another frame (e.g., an "Ashford inkle loom"), you can also screw a 3mm screw into the existing hole and wrap the thread around it. When you want to store the LoopLoom, you can loosen the screw that secures the base and pull the base out. It then snaps into place—with a click—in the center of the frame, making the LoopLoom even more portable: That's exactly how the frame with the foot comes out of your printer. Apply a little pressure to the foot to remove it, slide it onto the frame from the back (there's a slot in the frame for this), and secure it with the screw that matches the frame's color: The print: 2 plates, 2 colors. Since the frame is very large, it tends to warp during printing. I’ve therefore made a few optimizations, which you can read about here . In my enclosed printers (P1S and X1C), this allows me to print the frame perfectly flat—which is important for the extensions to work properly. Either use my print profile or slice it yourself: Start with a 0.16 mm profile as a base, set the infill to 10% gyroid, and adjust the number of walls for the different parts: Cover caps: 2 Screws, base: 3 Frame: 4 Slide-outs: 5 Slide-out 3—the longest one—should be as sturdy as possible: 7 walls and 50% infill. Although I usually print with engineering filaments, plain PLA is the best choice here because stiffness is key. If you have PLA-CF, you can use it for the extensions (i.e., for Plate 2), but it’s not necessary. Here, I printed the first plate in “PLA matte dark brown” and the second in “PLA matte dark chocolate brown”: Some of the pieces on Plate 2 have changed since the photo was taken, and a shuttle has been added: If you prefer weaving shuttles that are a little bigger and fit better in your hand, here’s another model I made. If you'd prefer the foot to be a little heavier or thicker (for example, so you can wedge it between your legs on the sofa more easily), just place the foot on a suitable wooden board. Trace around it and cut it out. Screw the foot onto the board—there are already 4 holes for countersunk screws. I'll take some photos of this soon. I hope you have a lot of fun weaving—if so, I'd love to see a photo of the border, but I'd also appreciate a like, a good review, or a boost! And of course, feel free to ask questions if things aren't working out as they should. If you'd like to sell the loom, please contact me. Update 19.07.2026 I made a slight modification to slide 3; it now has a height-adjustable foot. This prevents the loom from wobbling when the slide bends upward slightly due to thread tension. You can easily reprint and replace the slide.

description: 3 parametrische Rohrmodelle Dieses Set enthält drei vollständig anpassbare Rohrmodelle für den MakerWorld Parametric Model Maker . Alle Abmessungen werden in Millimetern angegeben und können direkt vor der Erstellung des Modells verändert werden. Enthalten sind: ein gerader Rohradapter zum Vergrößern oder Reduzieren eines Durchmessers ein Rohrwinkel mit frei einstellbarem Winkel eine U-förmige Rohrbefestigung für die Wand Die Modelle eignen sich unter anderem für Werkstattprojekte, Absaugungen, Belüftungen, Kabeldurchführungen, Modellbau und individuelle Rohrinstallationen. 1. Rohradapter / Reduzierstück mit 45°-Übergang Der Rohradapter verbindet zwei unterschiedliche Rohrdurchmesser miteinander. Zwischen den beiden geraden Rohrabschnitten befindet sich ein automatisch berechneter, konischer Übergang mit einer Flankensteigung von 45° . Der Adapter kann sowohl als Reduzierstück als auch als Vergrößerungsstück verwendet werden. Sind beide Durchmesser identisch, entsteht automatisch ein gerades Rohrstück. Einstellbare Parameter diameter_1 – Außendurchmesser der ersten Seite diameter_2 – Außendurchmesser der zweiten Seite thickness – Wandstärke des Adapters length – Länge jedes geraden Rohrabschnitts bis zum 45°-Übergang Die Länge des konischen Übergangs wird automatisch anhand der beiden Durchmesser berechnet. Wichtig diameter_1 und diameter_2 beziehen sich auf die Außendurchmesser des gedruckten Adapters . Die jeweiligen Innendurchmesser ergeben sich aus: Innendurchmesser = Außendurchmesser − 2 × Wandstärke Der Begriff „45°“ beschreibt hier den konischen Übergang zwischen den Durchmessern und nicht eine Richtungsänderung des Rohres. Geeignet für Rohrreduzierungen und Rohrerweiterungen Absaug- und Lüftungsleitungen Schlauch- und Geräteanschlüsse Werkstattadapter individuelle Übergangsstücke 2. Parametrischer Rohrwinkel Das zweite Modell erzeugt ein gebogenes, hohles Rohrstück mit frei einstellbarer Richtungsänderung. Dadurch können beispielsweise 30°-, 45°-, 60°- oder 90°-Winkel erstellt werden. Auf beiden Seiten des Bogens befindet sich ein gerader Rohrabschnitt mit identischer Länge. Einstellbare Parameter diameter – Außendurchmesser des Rohrwinkels thickness – Wandstärke des Rohrwinkels length – gerade Rohrlänge je Seite, gemessen ab dem Bogen angle – gewünschte Richtungsänderung in Grad Der Biegeradius wird automatisch passend zum eingestellten Rohrdurchmesser erzeugt. Wichtig diameter bezeichnet den Außendurchmesser des gedruckten Rohrwinkels . Der Innendurchmesser ergibt sich aus: Innendurchmesser = diameter − 2 × thickness Der Parameter length gilt für beide Seiten einzeln. Bei einer Einstellung von 30 mm besitzt der Winkel daher vor und nach dem Bogen jeweils einen geraden Rohrabschnitt von 30 mm. Geeignet für Rohrleitungen mit individuellen Winkeln Absaug- und Belüftungssysteme Kabel- oder Schlauchführungen Modellbau Prototypen und Sonderlösungen 3. Rohrbefestigung für die Wand Das dritte Modell ist eine U- beziehungsweise Omega-förmige Rohrhalterung. Das Rohr wird vom gebogenen Bereich umschlossen, während die beiden nach außen umgeklappten Enden an einer Wand oder einer anderen ebenen Fläche befestigt werden können. In den beiden Befestigungslaschen befinden sich Schraublöcher. Einstellbare Parameter diameter – Außendurchmesser des zu befestigenden Rohres thickness – Materialstärke der Halterung width – Breite der Halterung entlang des Rohres Die Länge der beiden Befestigungslaschen wird automatisch an den Rohrdurchmesser angepasst. Passung und Schraublöcher Das Modell besitzt standardmäßig ein radiales Spiel von ungefähr 0,4 mm . Dadurch ist der Innendurchmesser der Halterung etwa 0,8 mm größer als der eingestellte Rohrdurchmesser. Beispiel: diameter = 40 mm Innendurchmesser der Halterung ≈ 40,8 mm Die beiden Befestigungslöcher besitzen in der aktuellen Version einen Durchmesser von 4,5 mm und sind damit beispielsweise für M4-Schrauben geeignet. Geeignet für Befestigung von Rohren und Schläuchen Kabel- und Leitungsführung Werkstatt- und Garageninstallationen Absaugrohre leichte Rohrsysteme und Modellbauprojekte Die mögliche Belastung hängt vom verwendeten Filament, der Wandstärke, der Druckausrichtung, den Schrauben und dem jeweiligen Untergrund ab. Hinweise zum 3D-Druck Für normale Anwendungen eignen sich PLA oder PETG. Für wärmere Umgebungen, Werkstätten oder Bereiche mit höherer mechanischer Belastung ist PETG, ASA oder ein vergleichbar widerstandsfähiges Material meist besser geeignet. Als Ausgangspunkt können folgende Einstellungen verwendet werden: Schichthöhe: 0,20 mm Wandlinien: 4–6 Obere/untere Lagen: 4–6 Infill: 25–40 % Der Rohradapter lässt sich durch seinen 45°-Übergang normalerweise ohne Stützmaterial drucken. Die Wandhalterung sollte mit den beiden Befestigungslaschen flach auf dem Druckbett positioniert werden. Beim Rohrwinkel kann abhängig vom gewählten Winkel und der Ausrichtung Stützmaterial erforderlich sein. Für Steck-, Klemm- oder Klebeverbindungen sollte zusätzlich eine passende Drucktoleranz berücksichtigt werden. Diese hängt vom Drucker, Filament und der gewünschten Passung ab. Für eine lose Steckverbindung sind häufig etwa 0,2 bis 0,5 mm Spiel pro Seite sinnvoll. Ein kurzer Testdruck ist bei präzisen Verbindungen empfehlenswert.

description: Looking for a custom adapter, fitting, reducer, or elbow? Look no further. AdapterGenerator is a fully parametric OpenSCAD generator for hollow adapters. Configure End A and End B independently using round or rectangular spigots and sockets, hose barbs, male or female threads, or bolted flanges, then connect them with a straight, offset, reducing, stepped, or bent transition. From vacuum hose adapters and duct transitions to threaded couplers, nozzles, reducers, and custom fittings, it's built for practical real-world connections. Fully printed system to make plaster moulds. This produces a 3-part mould to cast a mini cauldron and lid This print has been scaled to 112% to account for clay shrinkage, which should give a final ornament size of 6cm diameter with most casting slips. If you want it smaller/larger than 6cm, scale every piece of the print. This design has a lid at one end and the cauldron at the other. You should be able to cast both at the same time (ish) by casting one end first, then casting the second while the slip is fully draining out the first. Because of the double ended design, this printed model is particularly difficult to demould from the plaster , and I've added several extra slots for extra flexibility (with extra caps to cover them while casting plaster). The more you sand/smooth your print and the better your release agent, the easier the process will be, but I wouldn't recommend this mould as a first project! With any fully 3D printed mould, you’ll benefit from using a release agent on the base plate surface. I use a generic mouldmaker’s soap, but any product designed for plaster release should be fine. It needs around 375ml of plaster, and you can calculate the weight of water and plaster needed with this tool: Plaster Calculator You can get a much better cast surface, even if your plaster mix is full of air bubbles, by using a paintbrush to dislodge any trapped air from the surface. I would suggest that you pour plaster until the ornament surface is covered but it isn’t completely full, then get a relatively small paintbrush and move it around in the plaster so that you’re brushing all of the details on the base plate surface. This will dislodge air bubbles, and once dislodged they’ll float upwards. Once you’ve finished this, pour in the rest of the plaster. If you manage to avoid adding more air as you do it (just brush gently), you’ll eventually remove all the bubbles from the surface and get a perfect cast. This uses the updated 3 part mould design, which is compatible with other updated 3 part moulds but not the original ornament moulds. This new design has slots added to the back to allow the mould to bend slightly when releasing the plaster, making the process much easier. This version has an additional larger slot in the print with a removable insert to stop plaster from leaking during casting. Remove the insert once you're ready to demould the plaster, then the added flexibility will allow the print to pop right off

model_name: Working Telescopic Micro Fishing Rod with reel
description: buymeacoffee.com/Metatronic All your boosts , likes and downloads inspire me to do more , this is also my full time job so any help is so much appricated , love you all :) Here is a link to a YT video explaining the idea and path to get here. https://youtu.be/TJRBcqbZE9c TL;DR A compact, fully 3D printed telescopic fishing rod inspired by Japanese micro-fishing. It collapses to around 100 mm, extends to roughly 300 mm, includes a working reel, and is designed to print flat on the bed for maximum strength. The Idea Behind It The idea for this rod came after I discovered Japanese micro-fishing, where people target extremely small fish and even hold competitions for the smallest catch. I had never really thought about fishing for tiny fish before, so I started researching the hooks, line and equipment used. My first version was made from wood, but it needed too much assembly and was not very practical. That made me think, I have a 3D printer, so why not design something that does exactly what I want? This rod is the result. It is designed for small fish, from little perch and similar species down to true micro-fishing sizes. Check out the video to see the wee perch I caught with it. Pocket-Sized Design The rod measures around 100 mm when collapsed and approximately 300 mm when fully extended . The goal was to make something small enough to keep in a pocket without it becoming a hassle to carry. It works well as a backup rod, or for those times when the bigger fish are not biting but there are plenty of smaller fish nearby. Designed for Strength This was one of the most important parts of the design. Most telescopic prints are printed vertically, which places force across the weaker layer lines. The square shape of this rod allows every telescopic section to be printed flat, so the layers run along the length of the rod instead. This gives it the strongest possible print orientation for its size. The rod feels surprisingly rigid when extended and can handle much more pressure than the small fish it is intended for. Working Reel The rod includes a clip-in reel with a small finger recess, allowing you to wind the line back in by hand. It can also be operated with your thumb, depending on which direction you spool the line. I kept the reel low-profile so the rod remains smooth and compact when collapsed. I may add an optional reel handle accessory in the future. Print Information The model is split across three print plates , making it easier to customise the colours. I highly recommend using the included print profiles, as a lot of testing went into getting the sliding tolerances working correctly. The full rod can be printed in PLA. Assembly Instructions 1. Assemble the Telescopic Sections The rod sections are tapered, so the correct direction should be visible by eye. Keep every part facing the same way, with the build-plate texture aligned on the same side. Slide the sections through one another, then pass the full assembly through the main body. Fit the butt cap onto the bottom once everything is in place. 2. Fit the Eyelets Press the eyelets onto the rod sections. They are designed to fit snugly, but printer tolerances vary, so I recommend using a very small dab of glue to stop them coming loose when the rod is collapsed. 3. Feed the Line Feed the line through: The top eyelet The second eyelet The third eyelet The body eyelet Pull enough line through to give yourself room to attach it to the reel. 4. Attach the Reel Before pressing the reel into the body, feed the line through the reel from the inside to the outside . Adding a small hook-shaped bend to the end of the line makes this easier. Pass the line through a few times, tie it securely, then carefully press the reel into place using firm, even pressure. Wind on your preferred amount of line. I used a few metres, which was plenty for testing. Hook and Weight Storage Once the rod is collapsed and the line has been reeled in, the hook and weight can be tucked into the butt cap. The cap then closes over the end, keeping the rig secure and stopping the hook from moving around loose in your pocket. Important: Tight Tolerances The telescopic sections use very tight tolerances to keep the rod smooth, secure and free from excessive movement. With some filaments, the sections may feel slightly stiff or may not fully extend at first. Gently work the affected section in and out a few times. The parts will usually wear themselves in and become smoother with use. This can vary depending on filament type, moisture and small differences in printing. If the sections remain unusually tight, make sure your filament is dry or try printing them with a different filament. FAQ How long is it? Around 100 mm collapsed and approximately 300 mm fully extended . What material should I use? PLA works well. Does the reel work? Yes, it can be used to wind the fishing line back in. Why is the rod square? The square shape allows the sections to print flat, placing the layer lines along the rod for better strength. Does it need glue? The main parts are designed to fit together without glue, but a tiny amount is recommended on the eyelets. Can it catch real fish? Yes. I caught a small few perch with it, which you can see in the video. enjoy the test pile :) remember for assembly Feed the line through: The top eyelet The second eyelet The third eyelet The body eyelet Pull enough line through to give yourself room to attach it to the reel. Before pressing the reel into the body, feed the line through the reel from the inside to the outside . Adding a small hook-shaped bend to the end of the line makes this easier. Pass the line through a few times, tie it securely, then carefully press the reel into place using firm, even pressure.

description: Gen 5 Glock 17 / 19 Magwell for Talon Grips A low-profile magwell designed for Gen 5 Glock 17 and Gen 5 Glock 19 frames, specifically sized to also fit over sandpaper style grip tape . This magwell was designed to also add a more secure lower grip area while keeping it simple, durable, and easy to print. Customized personally the fuzzy skin profile to be aggressive. The lower swell is intentionally shaped higher where your pinky sits, helping give the hand a firmer purchase on the grip. Hardware Uses an M3 flat-style screw . The best-fitting screws I found were spare Holosun RDS screws , which sat flush and fit the design cleanly. Fitment / Install Notes This is a very tight fit. Before installing, visually and physically confirm the firearm is clear and unloaded, then remove the slide. Start at the back of the magwell where the rear pillar inserts. Squeeze both sides of the magwell inward and make sure they are seated inside the frame channels. Once both sides are in the channels, press down with your thumb on the back of the magwell to keep it in place. Next, squeeze the front of the magwell and do the same thing, making sure the front edges are also inside the channels. Once everything is lined up and sitting inside the channels, push the magwell into place. It should pop in. Again, this is a tight fit. Only use an amount of force you are comfortable with and that you know your firearm can handle. Do not force it if something looks misaligned. Testing / Disclaimer Personally tested with over 500 rounds in a single session to check fit and durability. That said, printed parts can vary. description: Say goodbye to a wet back and butt with this Tesla air conditioning kit for ventilated seat covers. (Without cover not tested) I bought ventilated seat covers for my 2022 Model 3, which was great—they keep you dry—but your back and butt still get hot when you get into a car that’s been sitting in the sun for 9 hours, even if it’s been pre-conditioned. So I designed a system that lets the rear AC to circulate cool air across your back and seat through an aftermarket ventilated seat cover—you can easily find these online; they’re the same models everywhere. The cover really helps distribute the cool airflow—the feeling is truly revolutionary. I’m not sure if this works well without the seat cover. I think you’d feel the plastic in your body since there isn’t the thickness of the cover to cushion it, but you can give it a try by You can cut in Bambu Studio the diffuser extensions to match your body, and driving position. Or simply don't fit the diffuser extensions, at least you will feel the AC at the bottom of your back for sure. But the seat cover creates a sort of tunnel that allows air to flow under your body without you blocking the airflow, all that with 10x fans, that's what makes the difference. Compatible with Model 3 and Model Y through 2023 (until the seat design changes). It may be compatible with the new Model 3 and Model Y, but I haven't been able to test it. By the way, if you're sensitive to the cold, you can turn on the heater in the winter in addition to the standard heated seats. Warning : Please note that is a DIY project and each driver have different driving/seat position so you may modify some pieces. Maybe you can use TPU to make flexible extension so that it would be more compatible without any modifications. You can try to heat the parts with heat gun to give it the form you want. The diffuser was designed for my seat adjustment; the angle of the seatback might restrict the diffuser. I'm providing a 2D drawing of the diffuser's profile so you can check if it would fit your setup. Otherwise, perhaps when installing the heater, you could adapt it to your setup—since it's a complex part, I haven't created any other versions. It's recommended to print it in heat resistant material like ABS, ASA, (maybe PETG but my car get 74°C at max), you can just try in PLA if you have the cabin overheat protection (that's how I made my first prototype to see if it worth it and damn it worth it !) Warping can be a bit annoying but doesn't prevent the assembly. I strongly recommend to print at 50% to avoid support at 45°. 60° overhang angle print good and I prefer to be safe and print slowly Assembly : First, You need to unclip the two elastic straps under the seat, at the back, that hold the small piece of leather cover in place. (white piece on my rear photo) Insert the main diffuser in the seat by the front to the rear, clip the diffuser extensions Insert 3x M6 nuts (or only 2) in the rear plenum, connect the rear plenum on the main diffuser with at least 2 screws to lock it Connect the 2x parts of the "Rear AC diffuser 2x Ø50 mm" by gluing them or using 4x plastic screw Put some sticky foam all around the part who goes in the Tesla vent, it make sure the part fits securely in the car, it prevent from moving. Be sure to make foam opening for the flaps like on photos I recommend to put foam around the flat surface to prevent from air leaks, it's a bit of a DIY I know, but it's worth it. Connect Ø50 mm air hoses with zip ties or collar to the plenum and to the the rear AC cover. If you have a ventilated seat cover then try to put the diffuser extensions (for butt and back) in the seat cover opening to really force the air to go in the seat cover, like sealing. For those who test without cover, feel free to share your felling :)

description: I picked up embroidery this year and every hoop I bought had the same problem: a metal screw sticking out of the edge, right where my thread wants to travel. It snagged on every pass. So I went looking for a hoop without one. Amazon, Etsy, the craft store. It does not exist. Spring hoops have fixed tension. Press-fit hoops do not adjust. Every adjustable hoop on earth puts the screw on the edge. So I moved it. On this hoop the entire tension mechanism lives in a small bridge behind the frame. The outside edge is completely smooth. You still tighten it clockwise like any hoop, you still get fine control (about 3 turns per millimeter), but there is nothing for your thread to catch on. Ever. Four oval sizes (60x80 up to 140x200 mm). All the hardware tucks completely inside. Prints without supports. Round sizes coming soon. WHAT YOU NEED PER HOOP (not included, standard hardware-store parts): 1x M4x30 socket head cap screw 2x M4 hex nuts a 3mm allen key (for assembly only) Any brand works, metric sizes are standard. Use socket head cap screws and plain hex nuts, not button-head screws and not nylon lock nuts. Always print knobs two at at least .16 high quality, .12mm is best PRINT: No supports, anywhere. Do not rotate parts. PETG recommended for inner rings (they flex when you mount fabric). 0.2mm rings, 0.12mm knobs. Snap the mouse ears off the knob after printing. SIMPLE . FLYING . FUN Motte RC is a compact two-channel RC biplane designed for relaxed flying on small fields. Smaller and more agile than Hummel RC , it trades a little speed for improved maneuverability and better stability in light wind. Its lightweight modular construction is durable, quick to print and requires little material, while the adjustable wing position makes CG and pitch tuning simple. The model has no movable control surfaces: altitude is controlled by total motor thrust, and turns are performed through differential thrust between the two wing-mounted motors. Motte RC is part of a growing series of simple 2-channel RC aircraft. Each model shares the same accessible control concept while offering a different configuration, appearance and flight character. Motte RC continues the ideas of WingStar , COMET , Wespe , SkyStar , DragonFly and Hummel RC in a compact, vintage-inspired and practical RC model made to fly often. Key Features Control: 2-channel differential thrust Motors: 2 × brushed motors Battery: 1S LiPo Adjustable wing position for CG and pitch tuning Recommended conditions: calm weather or light breeze Suitable for small outdoor fields Why Motte RC? Quick and material-efficient to print Simple modular assembly Easy, Beginners' friendly, two-channel control Replaceable and easy-to-reprint parts Mix and match selected parts from Hummel RC, WingStar, Wespe and COMET to create your own configurations More compatible parts and modular configurations are planned for future updates. 1 - Model Datasheet Wingspan: 346 mm Length: 293 mm Wing chord: 60 mm RC Transmitter and receiver: 2Channel 2.4G FX803 J3 (or equal), link here Battery: 3.7v, 220 mAh, Molex 51005 connector (or equal), link here Motors and Props: 2x716 Coreless motors with 2 props diam 46 mm (or equal), link here Model mass (with RC receiver, battery and motors): 50 g. 2 – Material, Settings, Printing Model design created and tested using Bambu PLA Basi c. Use this material for best results. Do NOT use PLA Matte, especially for the wing parts. Printed parts may deform after removal from the Plate due to internal material strains after cooling. Use recommended print settings. Note: The print profile for A1 mini use slightly higher material flow coefficient (1.03 instead of 0.98). For reliable printing: Clean the printing Plate before printing. After printing, remove the Plate and let it cool for 3-4 minutes Do not remove parts while the Plate is hot. 3 - Model Assembly The model consists of 18 parts, as shown in the figure. 1 – Nose, 2 – PCB Mount, 3 – A-Beam , 4 – B-Beam, 5 – Strut, 6 – Sting, 7 – Tail, 8 – Fin, 9 – Central Bracket, 10 – Dual-pin, 11 – Right Wing, 12 – Left Wing , 13 – Right Rib, 14 – Left Rib, 15 – Gear Strut (Right and Left), 16 – Wheel (2pcs), 17 – Pin (2pcs), 18 – BHCS Screw M2 x 4 mm (3 pcs). RC Receiver, Engines, props are not shown. The following assembly steps are shown without the electronic components installed. It is recommended to review them before installing the motors and electronics. Use cyanoacrylate glue where specifically indicated. Assemble the tail unit and fuselage as shown. Assemble the wing as shown in the figures. Use Dual-pin to fix wings. After installing and fixing the wing surfaces, install Wing Ribs (13, 14) on both sides. Assemble the landing gear struts as shown in the pictures below. Install landing gear struts in Central Bracket (9). Pay attention on proper positioning of right and left struts. Check correct positioning before application of glue. As final step, mount the fixing screw BHCS Screw M2 x 4 mm (18) in Central Bracket (9). Wing and landing gear assembly completed. To install the wing on the fuselage, pull the fuselage beam through predefined guide points on the wing Central Bracket, as shown in the picture. A slight pushing force may be gently applied if needed. 3.1 – Electronic Components Installation Install RC transmitter on PCB bracket (2). Finally, connect the motors to the receiver board as shown in the illustration. Before final assembly, make sure the motors rotate in opposite directions. For easier assembly and adjustment, the wires should be approximately 130-140 mm long. The wires are preferable to route through the rib. To install the motor in the rib, gently press it into place and slide it slightly forward until there is no gap. To prevent the motor from rotating during operation, secure it with a small piece of adhesive tape, as shown in the illustration. Install the ribs with the motors onto the wing as shown in the illustration. The motors must be positioned on the outer side of each rib. Install the assembled wing onto the fuselage beam, approximately 10 mm from the fuselage forward end. Then route the motor wires behind the lower fuselage beam on each side, then twist the wires together for several turns, as shown in the illustration. Only after routing the wires, install the PCB receiver bracket (2). Install the nose part (1) and secure it with screw (18). Install the battery and hold it in place with a suitable rubber band, as shown on picture. Position the wing so that the distance from the rear edge of the upper central bracket to the tail-boom joint is approximately 42 mm, as shown in the illustration. Fix finally the screw (18) of wing assembly. The model assembly is now complete. 3.2 – Balancing Pre-flight balancing not required when assembled as described above. CG positioned approximately 10 mm from the bottom wing leading edge. 4 - Model Flight Launch the model outdoors in calm weather or slight breeze conditions. Recommended wind speed: up to 5 km/h (≈1.4 m/s, ≈2.7 knots) . Always launch the model directly into the wind . Launch the model applying full throtle with a gentle horizontal push. If the model dives strongly, then: Move the wing slightly forward OR bend the elevator slightly upward If the model pitches up or stalls, first try reducing the flight speed. If flight speed reduction does not help, then: Move the wing slightly backward OR bend the elevator slightly downward Flight tip: For a ground takeoff, apply full throttle. After a takeoff run of about 10–12 meters , make a gentle turn in either direction. This slight bank helps the model lift off. Happy Flights and Smooth Landings!

Fully printed system to make plaster moulds. This produces a 3-part mould to cast round ornaments with a pumpkin design. This print has been scaled to 112% to account for clay shrinkage, which should give a final ornament size of 6.5cm diameter with most casting slips. If you want it smaller/larger than 6.5cm, scale every piece of the print. With any fully 3D printed mould, you’ll benefit from using a release agent on the base plate surface. I use a generic mouldmaker’s soap, but any product designed for plaster release should be fine. It needs around 375ml of plaster, and you can calculate the weight of water and plaster needed with this tool: Plaster Calculator You can get a much better cast surface, even if your plaster mix is full of air bubbles, by using a paintbrush to dislodge any trapped air from the surface. I would suggest that you pour plaster until the ornament surface is covered but it isn’t completely full, then get a relatively small paintbrush and move it around in the plaster so that you’re brushing all of the details on the base plate surface. This will dislodge air bubbles, and once dislodged they’ll float upwards. Once you’ve finished this, pour in the rest of the plaster. If you manage to avoid adding more air as you do it (just brush gently), you’ll eventually remove all the bubbles from the surface and get a perfect cast. This uses the updated 3 part mould design, which is compatible with other updated 3 part moulds but not the original ornament moulds. This new design has slots added to the back to allow the mould to bend slightly when releasing the plaster, making the process much easier. This version has an additional larger slot in the print with a removable insert to stop plaster from leaking during casting. Remove the insert once you're ready to demould the plaster, then the added flexibility will allow the print to pop right off!

Parametrische Kabeldurchführungsplatte Die Kabeldurchführungsplatte kann mit bis zu zehn individuell einstellbaren Kabelöffnungen erzeugt werden. Jede Öffnung kann unabhängig aktiviert, deaktiviert und in ihrem Durchmesser angepasst werden. Je nach Anzahl der verwendeten Öffnungen und den gewählten Außenabmessungen ordnet das Modell die Kabeldurchführungen automatisch in einer oder zwei Reihen an. Dabei können innerhalb einer Platte sowohl gleich große als auch unterschiedlich große Öffnungen verwendet werden. Um jede Kabelöffnung befindet sich ein erhöhter Verstärkungskranz. Dieser stabilisiert die Öffnung, schützt die Plattenkante und sorgt für eine saubere Kabelführung. Der Übergang zwischen Kranz und Grundplatte ist abgeschrägt und für einen stützmaterialarmen Druck optimiert. Die Schalter werden von vorne durch die runden Öffnungen eingesetzt und anschließend mit ihrer Befestigungsmutter am Panel fixiert.
